source: S2Arm 将尝试通用构建；打包成功不代表游戏已通过兼容性验证。
en: S2Arm will try a generic build; packing successfully does not mean the game passed compatibility checks.

source: 新增内容或引擎更新还没重新打包；启动将使用上次成功版本。
en: New content or engine updates aren’t packed yet; launching uses the last successful build.

source: 下次启动生效，无需重新打包。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Takes effect next launch; no repacking needed. The game must support the language.

source: 重新打包
en: Pack again

source: 打包条件未满足

source: 游戏一款一款依次打包；打包时可以继续添加游戏、改按键。
en: Games pack one at a time; you can keep adding games and editing controls meanwhile.

source: 放进来的游戏会自动打包，进度在这里看。
en: Games you add pack automatically; follow progress here.

source: 密钥只需导入一次，所有游戏共用；只保存在本机，不随诊断包导出。添加的游戏放进来就自动打包，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。
en: Keys are imported once and shared by all games; they stay on this Mac and are never included in diagnostics. Added games pack automatically; updates and DLC merge by version.

source: 打包前检查应用内置组件和 Xcode；启动已打包的游戏只检查运行所需组件。
en: Packing checks bundled components and Xcode; launching packed games only checks what running needs.

source: S2Arm 引擎、Python 及其依赖、.NET 运行时、打包工具和共享字体都随应用内置。打包游戏需要完整 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件（缺了在检测项旁一键处理），启动已打包的游戏不需要 Xcode。玩家只需放入 prod.keys 和游戏（本体、更新、DLC）。
en: The S2Arm engine, Python and its dependencies, the .NET runtime, packing tools and shared fonts are all bundled. Packing games needs full Xcode and its Metal Toolchain (fix with one click next to the check); launching packed games does not. Just add your prod.keys and games (base, updates, DLC).

source: 与界面语言独立；可在游戏详情中单独设置启动语言。下次启动生效，无需重新打包或导入固件。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Independent of the interface language; set a per-game launch language in game details. Takes effect next launch; no repacking or firmware import needed. The game must support the language.

source: 已打包的游戏可以启动，打包环境还需修复
en: Packed games can launch; the packing environment still needs fixing

source: S2Arm、Python、.NET 和共享字体随应用内置。打包还需要 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件，缺了在检测项旁一键处理；玩家只需放入密钥和游戏。
en: S2Arm, Python, .NET and shared fonts are bundled. Packing also needs Xcode and its Metal Toolchain; fix with one click next to the check. Just add your keys and games.

source: S2Arm 引擎随应用内置，包含 Mac 宿主、NSP/XCI 读取器和游戏打包工具。玩家数据与构建缓存独立保存。
en: The S2Arm engine is bundled: the Mac host, NSP/XCI reader and game packing tools. Player data and build caches are stored separately.

source: 读不出这个游戏：你的 prod.keys 解不开它。多半是密钥太旧（导出密钥的 Switch 系统版本比游戏要求的低），请把 Switch 更新到最新系统后重新导出 prod.keys，到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入，再放一次游戏。如果密钥是新的，可能是游戏文件不完整，请重新复制或下载后再试。
en: Can’t read this game: your prod.keys can’t decrypt it. Most likely the keys are too old (dumped from a Switch on a lower system version than the game needs). Update your Switch to the latest system, dump prod.keys again, re-import them in Settings → Player keys, then add the game again. If your keys are new, the game file may be incomplete; copy or download it again.

source: 连着的设备上没找到 S2Arm 打的游戏 App，或者这些 App 还没运行过、没有日志。
en: No S2Arm game apps found on the connected device, or they haven’t run yet and have no logs.

en: Packing for iPhone needs the .NET 10 SDK. Click “Install” to download it from Microsoft into your user folder (about 300 MB, no admin password). Not needed to play on Mac.

en: Packing for iPhone needs the .NET SDK. Click “Install” in Settings’ environment checks, then click “Pack for iPhone” again.

en: The bundled engine is too old to pack for iPhone. Install the latest S2Arm.

en: When on, an AI assistant on this Mac (such as Claude Code) can add keys and games, pack, build iPhone packages, read why something failed and retry for you. Local only; other devices cannot connect.

en: (run help first)

source: 规则：只在这台 Mac 上操作；不要上传、复制或打印 prod.keys 和游戏文件；遇到失败先看任务里的错误码和恢复建议再重试。
en: Rules: work only on this Mac; never upload, copy or print prod.keys or game files; when something fails, read the task's error code and recovery suggestion before retrying.

source: 无法解密或校验这个游戏；可能是密钥不匹配，也可能是游戏文件不完整。
en: The game could not be decrypted or verified. The keys may not match, or the game files may be incomplete.

source: 任务所在磁盘空间不足。
en: The task disk has insufficient space.

source: 这块盘读写出错
en: This drive had a read/write error

source: 这块盘读写出错：系统报告硬件或连接故障。
en: This drive had a read/write error: the system reported a hardware or connection fault.

source: 这块盘读写出了错（硬件或连接问题）：插稳数据线、换个接口，或用系统自带的磁盘检查工具查一下这块盘；也可以把游戏库搬到别的盘再试。存档和已出好的版本不受影响。
en: This drive had a read/write error (hardware or connection problem): reseat the cable, try another port, or check the drive with the system's disk check tool; you can also move the game library to another drive and try again. Your saves and finished builds are not affected.

source: 文件或目录不可访问或不可写。
en: A file or folder cannot be accessed or written.

source: 任务所需的文件或目录不存在。
en: A file or folder required by the task does not exist.

source: 任务所需的工具无法启动：{0}
en: A tool required by the task could not start: {0}

source: 所选游戏文件或文件夹不存在。
en: The selected game file or folder does not exist.

source: 在「设置 → 玩家密钥」导入自行导出的 prod.keys，然后重新导入游戏。
en: Import your own prod.keys in Settings → Player keys, then import the game again.

source: 重新选择完整的 prod.keys 文本文件，不要手工补写密钥值；原有密钥保持不变。
en: Select a complete prod.keys text file again. Do not fill in key values by hand; your existing keys are kept.

source: 核对自行导出的密钥是否匹配游戏所需版本，并检查游戏文件完整性，然后重新导入；此错误不能单独确定是密钥还是文件问题。
en: Check that your exported keys match the game requirements and verify the game files, then import again. This error alone cannot distinguish a key mismatch from damaged files.

source: 选择 NSP、XCI 文件或包含它们的文件夹，然后重新导入。
en: Select an NSP or XCI file, or a folder containing them, then import again.

source: 确认所选文件夹包含 NSP 或 XCI 文件，再重新导入。
en: Check that the selected folder contains NSP or XCI files, then import again.

source: 重新连接存储磁盘，确认文件仍在原位置且可读取；托管游戏文件缺失时，请从原始文件重新导入。
en: Reconnect the storage drive and check that the files are still readable at their original locations. Import missing managed game files again from your originals.

source: 将对应的游戏本体 NSP 或 XCI 一并导入；仅更新或 DLC 不能单独打包。
en: Import the matching base-game NSP or XCI as well. An update or DLC alone cannot be packaged.

source: 这款游戏的 32 位 ARM 程序暂不支持，重试无法解决；请选择 64 位 ARM 游戏。
en: 32-bit ARM game programs are not supported. Retrying will not fix this; choose a 64-bit ARM game.

source: 检查原始游戏文件是否完整，重新导入后再试；仍失败时复制错误摘要并保留对应日志。
en: Check that the original game files are complete, then import and retry. If it still fails, copy the error summary and keep the task log.

source: 释放任务所在磁盘的空间，检查游戏库和应用数据所在磁盘后重试；不要删除存档或上次成功的运行版本。
en: Free space on the task disk. Check both the game-library and app-data disks before retrying; keep your saves and last working release.

source: 检查文件和目录权限；若位于桌面、文稿、下载或外接磁盘，请在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 文件与文件夹」允许 S2Arm 访问，再重试。
en: Check file and folder permissions. For Desktop, Documents, Downloads or external drives, allow S2Arm access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders, then retry.

source: 当前路径需要 Apple Silicon Mac，请换用支持的设备；重试不会改变硬件兼容性。
en: This path requires an Apple Silicon Mac. Use a supported device; retrying cannot change hardware compatibility.

source: 当前游戏路径需要 macOS 15 或更新版本；在支持的系统上重新检查环境后再试。
en: The current game path requires macOS 15 or later. Recheck the environment on a supported system, then retry.

source: 在设置中检查所选 Xcode 是否完整且包含所需平台 SDK，打开 Xcode 完成设置后重新检查环境。
en: In Settings, check that the selected Xcode is complete and includes the required platform SDK. Open Xcode to finish setup, then recheck the environment.

source: 打开所选 Xcode，同意许可并完成首次设置，返回 S2Arm 重新检查环境。
en: Open the selected Xcode, accept its license and finish initial setup, then return to S2Arm and recheck the environment.

source: 开发模式需要 .NET 10 SDK；完整应用请重新安装以恢复内置运行时，然后重新检查环境。
en: Development mode needs the .NET 10 SDK. For the complete app, reinstall it to restore the bundled runtime, then recheck the environment.

source: 在「设置」的环境检查中安装 .NET 10 SDK，完成后重新检查，再打 iPhone 包。
en: Install the .NET 10 SDK from the environment checks in Settings, recheck, then generate the iPhone package again.

source: 开发模式请在设置中重新准备引擎工具；完整应用请重新安装，然后重新导入游戏。
en: In development mode, prepare the engine tools again in Settings. For the complete app, reinstall it, then import the game again.

source: 重新选择完整的 S2Arm 源码目录；使用完整应用时，请重新安装应用后检查环境。
en: Select a complete S2Arm source directory. For the complete app, reinstall it and recheck the environment.

source: 检查本任务日志中缺少的工具；开发模式补齐构建依赖，完整应用则重新安装，然后重试。
en: Check the task log for the missing tool. Install the build dependency in development mode, or reinstall the complete app, then retry.

source: 重新打包这款游戏以恢复完整运行文件；保留原有存档，打包成功后再启动。
en: Package this game again to restore complete runtime files. Keep your saves, then launch after packaging succeeds.

source: 检查游戏输入
en: Check game inputs

source: 检查导入文件
en: Check import files

source: 先把 Switch 更新到最新系统，重新导出 prod.keys，到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入，再放一次游戏；如果密钥已是新的，请检查游戏文件是否完整，重新复制后再试。
en: Update your Switch to the latest system, export prod.keys again, import it in Settings → Player keys, then add the game again. If your keys are already current, check that the game files are complete and copy them again before retrying.

source: 去 App Store 安装 Xcode，装好打开一次并完成必要组件安装，回来点「重新检查」。
en: Install Xcode from the App Store, open it once and finish installing its required components, then return and click Check again.

source: 打开 Xcode，同意许可并完成首次设置，回来点「重新检查」。
en: Open Xcode, accept the license and finish initial setup, then return and click Check again.

source: 重新安装完整的 S2Arm，恢复内置运行时后点「重新检查」。

source: 启动器出的包是自签的，iPhone 不认，要用你自己的 Apple ID 重新签一次。按下面五步做：
en: The launcher's package is self-signed and iPhone won't accept it as is. Re-sign it once with your own Apple ID in these five steps:

source: 在 Mac 上装 AltServer，再用它把 AltStore 装到 iPhone（按 altstore.io 官网说明）。推荐 AltStore Classic 2.2 或更新；不要用 SideStore 0.7.0，它会丢掉「提高内存上限」权限，大型游戏会打不开。
en: Install AltServer on your Mac and use it to put AltStore on your iPhone (see altstore.io). AltStore Classic 2.2 or later is recommended. Don't use SideStore 0.7.0: it drops the Increased Memory Limit entitlement and large games won't open.

source: iPhone 上打开「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」，打开后按提示重启。
en: On your iPhone, turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode, then restart when asked.

source: 把出好的 .ipa 用隔空投送或「文件」App 传到 iPhone，在 AltStore「我的 App」里点左上角「+」选它，按提示登录 Apple ID 完成安装。免费账号就可以。
en: Send the .ipa to your iPhone with AirDrop or the Files app. In AltStore, open My Apps, tap + at the top left, choose it and sign in with your Apple ID to install. A free account works.

source: 用数据线连上 iPhone，打开访达，左边选你的 iPhone →「文件」→ 找到这款游戏的 App，把同一文件夹里的整个「资源包」文件夹拖到它上面。

source: 免费 Apple ID 签的 App 7 天过期：Mac 上开着 AltServer、和 iPhone 在同一个 Wi-Fi 下会自动续签；过期了在 AltStore 点「刷新全部」，不用重新拷资源包。
en: Apps signed with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days. With AltServer running on your Mac and both on the same Wi-Fi, AltStore renews them automatically; if one expires, tap Refresh All in AltStore. You don't need to copy the resource pack again.

source: 会删除这款游戏的 iPhone 包（IPA）、资源包、出包中间产物和缓存，并从游戏库移除；存档和原始游戏文件保留。
en: This deletes the game's iPhone package (IPA), resource pack, build intermediates and caches, and removes it from the library. Saves and original game files are kept.

source: 检查当前阶段的配置推导错误，保留原始游戏输入；更新完整引擎后重新准备，仍失败时反馈错误摘要。
en: Check the configuration inference error and keep the original input. Update the complete engine and prepare again; report the error summary if it persists.

source: 检查着色器抽取的具体错误；确认游戏输入完整且版本一致，重新准备后仍失败时反馈摘要。
en: Check the shader extraction error. Confirm complete, matching game inputs, prepare again, and report the summary if it persists.

source: 保留着色器翻译错误摘要并更新完整引擎后重试；翻译未支持的输入不能通过重新签名解决。
en: Keep the shader translation error summary and update the complete engine before retrying. Re-signing cannot fix unsupported shader input.

source: 按编译错误检查 Xcode、Metal 组件和 .NET SDK；完成环境检查后重试，保留原有成功版本与存档。
en: Check Xcode, Metal components, and the .NET SDK against the compiler error. Recheck the environment and retry; keep the previous working version and saves.

source: 检查程序改写的首个错误；保留原始游戏文件，更新完整引擎后重试，仍失败时反馈摘要。
en: Check the first program rewriting error. Keep the original game files, update the complete engine, and report the summary if retrying fails.

source: 检查资源准备错误和输入目录权限，确认资源完整后重新准备；不要删除存档或上次成功的包。
en: Check resource preparation errors and input permissions, then prepare complete resources again. Do not delete saves or the last successful package.

source: 这一步的失败还没归类：错误摘要里有失败阶段、退出码和错误原文，点「复制错误摘要」发给我们。
en: This failure is not classified yet: the error summary has the failed stage, exit code and error text. Click "Copy error summary" and send it to us.

source: 磁盘空间不够：准备这个游戏需要更多空余空间。
en: Not enough disk space. Preparing this game needs more free space.

source: 暂时出不了包：这款游戏里有程序代码我们的改写器还不支持，我们正在修。
en: Can't build this game yet. This game uses code our rewriter doesn't support yet. We're working on a fix.

source: 着色器编译暂不支持：这款游戏的着色器编译目前只能在 Mac 上完成。
en: Shader compilation not available. Shader compilation for this game is currently only available on Mac.

source: 缺少 Metal 组件：编着色器要用的 Metal 组件没装上。
en: Metal not available. The Metal component needed for shader compilation is not installed.

source: 在设置里点「iOS 平台组件」的「一键下载」（苹果官方，约 8 GB），下完自动重新检查后重试；也可以打开 Xcode → 设置 → Components 装上与 Xcode 配套的 iOS 平台。
en: In Settings, click Download next to “iOS Platform Components” (from Apple, about 8 GB); it rechecks automatically when done, then try again. You can also open Xcode → Settings → Components and install the iOS platform that matches your Xcode.

source: 缺少 iOS 平台组件：Xcode 的 iOS 平台还没装，打不了 iPhone 包。
en: iOS Platform Components not installed: Xcode's iOS platform is not installed, so iPhone packages cannot be built.

en: iOS Platform Components

en: Download iOS Platform Components

en: iOS Platform Components installed.

source: 下载 Xcode 的 iOS 平台组件（约 8 GB）
en: Downloading Xcode's iOS Platform Components (about 8 GB)

source: 已装 Xcode 的 iOS {0} 平台组件。
en: Xcode's iOS {0} Platform Components are installed.

source: Xcode 的 iOS {0} 平台组件已经下载，但还没注册就绪：点「重新检查」再看一遍；不用重复下载（约 8 GB）。只在 Mac 上玩不需要它。
en: Xcode's iOS {0} Platform Components are downloaded but not registered yet: click Check again. There is no need to download the ~8 GB package again. Not needed if you only play on this Mac.

source: Xcode 的 iOS {0} 平台组件还没装（新装或刚升级的 Xcode 要另下）：打 iPhone 包、装到 iPhone 都要用它。点「一键下载」自动安装（苹果官方，约 8 GB，要些时间），下完自动重新检查。只在 Mac 上玩不需要它。
en: Xcode's iOS {0} Platform Components are not installed (a new or newly upgraded Xcode installs them separately): building iPhone packages and installing to iPhone need them. Click Download to install them automatically (from Apple, about 8 GB; it takes a while); the check runs again when it finishes. Not needed if you only play on this Mac.

source: 已下载 iOS 平台组件，但复查仍未通过。请在「设置 → 环境检查」查看 iOS 平台一项的说明。
en: The iOS platform was downloaded, but the recheck still failed. See the iOS platform item in Settings → Environment Check.

source: iOS 平台组件已经下载，只是还没注册到模拟器：点「重新检查」再试；不用重复下载（约 8 GB）。还不行就在 Xcode → 设置 → Components 里确认这一项，或重启这台 Mac 后再点「重新检查」。
en: The iOS platform is downloaded but not registered with the simulator yet: click Check again; there is no need to download the ~8 GB package again. If that does not help, check this item in Xcode → Settings → Components, or restart this Mac and check again.

en: Content rejected. The file structure did not validate; the copy may be incomplete.

en: Game file missing: the selected game file is no longer where it was.

source: 按安装错误检查设备连接与包的有效性；保持手机解锁后重试，保留原 App 和存档。
en: Check the device connection and package validity against the install error. Retry with the phone unlocked; keep the original app and saves.

source: 解锁手机并检查数据线及剩余空间后重试资源传输；保留已有 App、存档和电脑上的资源包。
en: Unlock the phone and check the cable and free space, then retry the resource transfer. Keep the app, saves, and local resource package.

source: 在 iPhone「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」按系统提示开启开发者模式，再重新安装。
en: Enable Developer Mode in iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security following the system instructions, then retry installation.

source: 重新用数据线连接并解锁 iPhone，在手机上确认「信任此电脑」，然后重新检查设备并安装。
en: Reconnect the iPhone by cable, unlock it, and confirm Trust This Computer. Recheck the device and install again.

source: 开发描述文件已过期；在 Xcode 重新登录签名账号、重新申请描述文件并签名安装，保留原 App 存档。
en: The provisioning profile expired. Sign in to the signing account in Xcode, renew the profile, and re-sign and install while keeping existing saves.

source: 已完成的安装包可以保留；检查磁盘余量与缓存目录权限后再清理缓存，不要删除游戏或存档。
en: Keep the completed package. Check free disk space and cache directory permissions before retrying cache cleanup; do not delete games or saves.

source: 当前阶段已超时；检查该阶段日志和设备连接，确认原因后重试，不要同时重复启动同一任务。
en: This stage timed out. Check its log and device connection before retrying; do not start duplicate tasks.

source: 重新选择可识别的目标机型与系统版本，或连接并解锁目标设备后重新检查。
en: Select a recognized target model and OS version, or connect and unlock the target device and recheck.

source: 任务缺少请求记录，无法安全接续；返回游戏库重新发起操作，不要手工修改任务记录。
en: The request record is missing, so this task cannot be safely resumed. Start again from the library without editing job records.

source: 此进程不属于当前任务，未发送停止信号；返回任务列表检查目标任务，不要强行结束其他进程。
en: This process does not belong to the task, so no stop signal was sent. Check the task list rather than terminating another process.

source: 原任务进程已经结束，当前进程号属于另一进程；刷新任务列表，不要按旧进程号停止任务。
en: The original task ended and its process ID was reused. Refresh the task list; do not stop a task using the old process ID.

source: 当前私有目录里没有这条任务；刷新任务列表并确认使用原游戏库，必要时重新发起操作。
en: This task is not in the current private directory. Refresh the task list and check the original library, or start a new operation.

source: 任务记录写入失败；检查磁盘空间和目录权限，保留产物与日志，恢复可写后重新检查任务。
en: The job record could not be written. Check disk space and directory permissions; keep artifacts and logs and recheck once writable.

source: 存档备份未完成，原存档保持不动；检查备份目录权限与空间后重新备份。
en: The save backup did not complete; the original save is unchanged. Check backup permissions and space and retry.

source: 备份期间存档发生变化；先正常退出游戏，再重新检查并备份存档。
en: The save changed during backup. Exit the game normally, then check and back up again.

source: 存档恢复已完成但事务清理未完成；保留备份和事务记录，检查目录权限后再检查恢复状态。
en: The save was restored but transaction cleanup is incomplete. Keep backups and transaction records, check permissions, and recheck recovery status.

source: 选择游戏库和应用私有目录之外、可写且有足够空间的备份目的地。
en: Choose a writable backup destination outside the game library and private app directory with sufficient space.

source: 当前没有可备份的存档；先在游戏中正常保存并退出，再重新检查。
en: There is no save to back up. Save in the game, exit normally, and check again.

source: 目标备份已经存在；选择新文件名或新目录，不要覆盖已有备份。
en: The backup destination already exists. Choose a new file name or directory instead of overwriting it.

source: 存档缺少有效的游戏程序号；重新选择原始备份，不要手工改写存档元数据。
en: The save has no valid game title ID. Select the original backup without manually editing its metadata.

source: 这份文件不是可识别的存档备份；重新选择由 S2Arm 导出的完整备份。
en: This file is not a recognized save backup. Select a complete backup exported by S2Arm.

source: 这款游戏尚未建立存档目录；先启动游戏并正常保存退出，再恢复备份。
en: This game has no save directory yet. Start it, save and exit normally, then restore the backup.

source: 存档回退没完成：事务记录与副本都保留着。可以先在存档页备份当前存档；确认可能丢掉没做完的导入 / 恢复后，可选「仍要启动」。不要删除事务目录。
en: The save rollback did not finish: the transaction record and copies are kept. You can back up the current saves on the Saves page first; after confirming you may lose the unfinished import / restore, you can choose “Launch anyway”. Do not delete the transaction folder.

source: 已按你的确认跳过存档回退启动游戏；事务记录保留，下次启动会再试恢复。
en: Launched the game skipping the save rollback as you confirmed; the record is kept and recovery is retried on the next launch.

source: 释放备份目的地的磁盘空间后重试；不要删除原存档或唯一的备份。
en: Free space at the backup destination and retry. Do not delete the original save or the only backup.

source: 存档路径含符号链接或不安全目录；选择普通目录中的完整备份，不要绕过路径保护。
en: The save path contains a symbolic link or unsafe directory. Select a complete backup in a regular directory without bypassing path protection.

source: 存档用户信息缺失或无效；重新选择游戏用户与原始备份，不要修改用户标识兜底。
en: The save user information is missing or invalid. Select the game user and original backup without substituting user IDs.

source: 备份与当前游戏版本或 DLC 不一致；使用匹配版本的游戏和备份后重试。
en: The backup does not match the game version or DLC. Retry with matching game inputs and backup.

source: 这份备份属于另一款游戏；回到对应游戏恢复，或选择当前游戏的备份。
en: This backup belongs to another game. Restore it in the matching game or select a backup for this game.

source: 这份备份属于另一用户；选择对应用户或该用户自己的备份后重试。
en: This backup belongs to another user. Select the matching user or their own backup and retry.

source: 免费 Apple ID 在每台设备上最多同时装 3 个自签 App，这台 {0} 已经装满：在设备上长按删掉一个不再玩的自签 App 后重试；或改用付费 Apple 开发者账号（没有这个上限）。
en: A free Apple ID can have at most 3 self-signed apps installed on a device at the same time, and this {0} is full. Touch and hold a self-signed app you no longer play on the device, remove it, and retry; or use a paid Apple Developer account, which has no such limit.

source: 让你选的那台 iPhone / iPad 连上这台电脑：插上数据线，或解锁后和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi；第一次连要在设备上点「信任」，并在「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」打开开发者模式，然后再试。
en: Connect the iPhone or iPad you chose to this computer: plug in a cable, or unlock it on the same Wi-Fi. The first time, tap Trust on the device and enable Developer Mode under Settings → Privacy & Security, then retry.

source: 在导出确认页勾上要装到的那台 iPhone / iPad，再点「开始」。
en: On the export page, tick the iPhone / iPad to install to, then click "Start".

source: 查看本任务日志里签名那一步的报错；确认 Xcode 能用你的账号给这台 {0} 签名，或改用 AltStore 安装。
en: Check the signing error in the job log. Confirm that Xcode can sign for this {0} with your account, or install with AltStore.

source: 本体已出好，照常安装即可；没解出的追加内容不在包里，游戏里用不到那部分内容。请导出诊断反馈，解码支持后重新打包即可带上。
en: The base game was packaged and can be installed as usual; the add-on content that could not be extracted is not in the package, so that content is unavailable in game. Please export a diagnostic report; repackage once decoding is supported to include it.

source: 已改从解包目录准备，本次照常完成，只是多花一些时间；游戏库放在 APFS 格式的磁盘上（Mac 内置盘或格式化为 APFS 的外接盘）时，各平台导出可以共用已准备好的游戏数据。
en: Preparation continued from the unpacked game data, so this export still finishes, only a little slower. When the game library is on an APFS disk (the Mac's internal disk or an external disk formatted as APFS), exports for different platforms can share the prepared game data.

source: 资源包已经在 {0} 上，不用重推：在设备上打开 S2Arm，选这款游戏，保持在前台别锁屏，等它导入完就能玩。
en: The resource pack is already on your {0}, so there is no need to send it again. Open S2Arm on the device, choose this game, keep it in the foreground with the screen on, and it will be ready once the import finishes.

source: 换一根支持 USB 3 的 USB-C 数据线，直接插 Mac 上的 USB-C / 雷雳口（不经扩展坞、集线器、显示器上的口），再装下一款；iPhone 15 Pro 及更新的 Pro 机型才支持 USB 3，其它机型只能 USB 2.0。
en: Use a USB 3 data cable directly in a Mac USB-C or Thunderbolt port without a hub or display. Only iPhone 15 Pro and newer Pro models support USB 3; other models use USB 2.0.

source: 装好的包能用；要在 iPhone Duo 等新机型上铺满全屏，把 Xcode 更新到不低于这台 iPhone 系统大版本的版本（如 iOS 27 用 Xcode 27），在启动器里选它后重新打 iPhone 包再装。
en: The installed app works. To fill the screen on newer models such as iPhone Duo, update Xcode to at least the iPhone's iOS major version (for iOS 27, Xcode 27), select it in the launcher, then rebuild and reinstall the iPhone package.

Check macOS, Xcode and Metal components,

Import prod.keys,
then add games and prepare runtime files.

source: 游戏库默认自动创建，也可切换位置。导入密钥后添加游戏。密钥通常只需导入一次，可供多款游戏共用；仅保存在本机私有目录，不随诊断包导出。
en: A default library is created automatically; you can change its location. Import your keys, then add games. Keys are shared across games, stored privately on this Mac and excluded from diagnostics.

source: 添加的游戏放进来就自动打包，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。准备完成后由你点击启动。

en: Choose a target platform and build with S2Arm’s existing tools.

en: S2Arm native Mac launcher with UI synchronized from LumaNX. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

source: 用数据线连接并解锁 iPhone / iPad，仅拉回诊断包与日志，不拉存档和游戏文件。

en: This game's memory configuration is damaged. Rebuild the game before launching it.

en: This launcher is out of date. Update it, then rebuild this game.

en: Rebuild this game before launching it.

source: 请更新 S2Arm，再重新编译这款游戏。
en: Update S2Arm, then rebuild this game.

source: HAP 导出：等待源码提供编译入口
en: HAP export: awaiting a source packaging entry point

source: 直接使用 S2Arm 已有的鸿蒙原生层构建功能。当前仅生成目标文件，尚未提供 HAP 编译功能。
en: Use the existing S2Arm HarmonyOS native build feature. It currently produces object files; HAP packaging is not yet available.

source: 当前引擎未声明 S2A_INPUT_CONFIG 支持。映射可保存，但游戏将使用引擎自己的默认操作；选择支持该接口的引擎并重新编译后才会应用。
en: This engine does not declare S2A_INPUT_CONFIG support. Mappings can be saved, but games use the engine defaults. Select an engine with this interface and packe the game again to apply mappings.

source: 所选 S2Arm 缺少 iOS 编译组件，请选择包含 dm/ios 的完整源码。
en: The selected S2Arm lacks iOS packaging components. Choose complete sources containing dm/ios.

source: 编译 IPA
en: Pack IPA

en: Development checkout (embedded when packaged)

source: 编译完成，可以启动了。
en: Compiling finished. Ready to launch.

source: 添加游戏文件夹或 NSP / XCI，放进来自动编译（⌘O）
en: Add a game folder or NSP / XCI files; they pack automatically (⌘O)

source:
把游戏拖到这里，或点下面的按钮。
放进来就自动编译，好了点启动。
en:
Drag games here or click the button below.
They pack automatically; launch when ready.

source: S2Arm 将尝试通用构建；编译成功不代表游戏已通过兼容性验证。
en: S2Arm will try a generic build; compiling successfully does not mean the game passed compatibility checks.

source: 新增内容或引擎更新还没重新编译；启动将使用上次成功版本。
en: New content or engine updates aren’t compiled yet; launching uses the last successful build.

source: 下次启动生效，无需重新编译。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Takes effect next launch; no repacking needed. The game must support the language.

source: 重新编译
en: Pack again

source: 编译条件未满足
en: Compiling requirements not met

source: 游戏一款一款依次编译；编译时可以继续添加游戏、改按键。
en: Games pack one at a time; you can keep adding games and editing controls meanwhile.

source: 放进来的游戏会自动编译，进度在这里看。
en: Games you add pack automatically; follow progress here.

source: 密钥只需导入一次，所有游戏共用；只保存在本机，不随诊断包导出。添加的游戏放进来就自动编译，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。
en: Keys are imported once and shared by all games; they stay on this Mac and are never included in diagnostics. Added games pack automatically; updates and DLC merge by version.

source: 编译前检查应用内置组件和 Xcode；启动已编译的游戏只检查运行所需组件。
en: Compiling checks bundled components and Xcode; launching compiled games only checks what running needs.

source: S2Arm 引擎、Python 及其依赖、.NET 运行时、编译工具和共享字体都随应用内置。编译游戏需要完整 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件（缺了在检测项旁一键处理），启动已编译的游戏不需要 Xcode。玩家只需放入 prod.keys 和游戏（本体、更新、DLC）。
en: The S2Arm engine, Python and its dependencies, the .NET runtime, compiling tools and shared fonts are all bundled. Compiling games needs full Xcode and its Metal Toolchain (fix with one click next to the check); launching compiled games does not. Just add your prod.keys and games (base, updates, DLC).

source: 与界面语言独立；可在游戏详情中单独设置启动语言。下次启动生效，无需重新编译或导入固件。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Independent of the interface language; set a per-game launch language in game details. Takes effect next launch; no repacking or firmware import needed. The game must support the language.

source: 已编译的游戏可以启动，编译环境还需修复
en: Packed games can launch; the compiling environment still needs fixing

source: S2Arm、Python、.NET 和共享字体随应用内置。编译还需要 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件，缺了在检测项旁一键处理；玩家只需放入密钥和游戏。
en: S2Arm, Python, .NET and shared fonts are bundled. Compiling also needs Xcode and its Metal Toolchain; fix with one click next to the check. Just add your keys and games.

source: S2Arm 引擎随应用内置，包含 Mac 宿主、NSP/XCI 读取器和游戏编译工具。玩家数据与构建缓存独立保存。
en: The S2Arm engine is bundled: the Mac host, NSP/XCI reader and game compiling tools. Player data and build caches are stored separately.

source: Xcode（编译时需要，自动找到）
en: Xcode (needed for compiling, found automatically)

source: 编译与启动都要
en: Needed to pack and launch

source: 编译时需要
en: Needed to pack

source: 编译中
en: Compiling

source: 未编译
en: Not compiled

source: 编译和运行互斥，请等当前任务结束。
en: Compiling and running can’t happen at the same time. Wait for the current task to finish.

source: 打开后，这台 Mac 上的 AI 助手（比如 Claude Code）可以替你放密钥、放游戏、编译、打 iPhone 包、看失败原因并重试。只在本机，别的设备连不进来。
en: When on, an AI assistant on this Mac (such as Claude Code) can add keys and games, pack, build iPhone packages, read why something failed and retry for you. Local only; other devices cannot connect.

source: 将对应的游戏本体 NSP 或 XCI 一并导入；仅更新或 DLC 不能单独编译。
en: Import the matching base-game NSP or XCI as well. An update or DLC alone cannot be packaged.

source: 重新编译这款游戏以恢复完整运行文件；保留原有存档，编译成功后再启动。
en: Package this game again to restore complete runtime files. Keep your saves, then launch after packaging succeeds.

source: 游戏运行版本链接已失效，请重新编译。
en: The installed game release link is broken. Pack the game again.

source: 运行版本的 NPDM 无效，请重新编译。
en: The installed game has an invalid NPDM. Pack it again.

source: 新版 Mac 宿主可从游戏菜单或菜单栏手柄图标查看本局键位。旧包需重新编译，改键下次启动生效。
en: New Mac hosts show this run's controls from the game menu or menu-bar controller icon. Rebuild old packages; binding changes apply next launch.

source: 开发中：现有构建只出原生目标文件，还没有 HAP 编译
en: In development: the current build only produces native object files; HAP packaging is not available yet

source: 启动器出的包是自签的，iPhone 不认，要用你自己的 Apple ID 重新签一次。编译本来就要装 Xcode，用它最省事：
en: The package is self-signed, so iPhone won't accept it until it's signed with your own Apple ID. You already have Xcode for compiling — that's the easiest way:

source: 添加的游戏放进来就自动编译，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。准备完成后由你点击启动。
en: Added games are prepared automatically; updates and DLC are merged by version. Launch a game when preparation finishes.

source: 编译成功不代表游戏已通过兼容性验证。
en: Successful preparation does not confirm game compatibility.

source: 改完下次启动生效，不用重新编译。
en: Changes take effect on the next launch. No rebuild needed.

source: 版本与你的游戏不同，编译时按特征跨版本定位
en: The version differs from your game. Matching across versions is performed during the build.

source: 宽屏和 60 帧是 S2Arm 自己的能力（从开源社区的补丁里学成的通用规律），按你的游戏版本匹配；匹配不到就自动不用。
en: Widescreen and 60 FPS are S2Arm's own capabilities (general rules learned from open-source community patches), matched to your game version. If no match is found, they are not used.

source: 包里不带社区补丁的原始数据。宽屏和 60 帧在这里（或 iPhone 的 App 设置）开关，下次启动生效，不用重新编译。
en: The build does not include raw community patch data. Toggle widescreen and 60 FPS here (or in the iPhone app settings). Changes take effect on the next launch without rebuilding.

source: ，下次编译时并入
en: ; will be included in the next build

source: 输入映射页面
en: Input mapping pages

source: 打开「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 文件与文件夹」（外接盘看「可移除的宗卷」），允许本应用读取游戏文件所在位置，或把游戏文件拷到「下载」之外的本机文件夹，然后重试。
en: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders (Removable Volumes for external drives) and allow this app to read the game file's location, or copy the game file to a local folder other than Downloads, then try again.

source: 确认游戏文件所在磁盘已连接、文件没有损坏（换一个位置拷一份再放），然后重试；反馈时复制错误摘要。
en: Make sure the drive holding the game file is connected and the file isn't damaged (copy it to another location and add it again), then try again. Copy the error summary when reporting.

source: 已自动安装 .NET SDK，但复查仍未通过，iPhone 包没有开始出。请在「设置 → 环境检查」查看 .NET 一项的说明，处理后再点「打 iPhone 包」。
en: .NET SDK was installed automatically, but the recheck still fails, so the iPhone package was not started. Open Settings → Environment check, follow the .NET item's instructions, then click “Pack for iPhone” again.

source: 鼠标移动控制右摇杆，停手后保持在原处，不回中。
en: Mouse movement drives the right stick and stays where you leave it; it does not recenter.

en: Choose an S2Arm backup file, or a JKSV, Checkpoint, yuzu or Ryujinx save folder or zip. A preview appears first, and nothing is restored until you confirm. Restoring replaces the current save, and a backup is made first.

source: 下面几项齐了就能装，这里每隔几秒自动检查一次。
en: You can install once everything below is ticked. This list checks itself every few seconds.

en: Installation starts automatically when everything is ready

en: Apps signed with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days. When that happens, connect your iPhone and install again; game files already on the phone aren't copied again. You can have up to 3 self-signed apps at a time.

source: 这款游戏的 iPhone 版已经做好
en: The iPhone version of this game is ready

source: 还没做好：先做 iPhone 版，做好后这里自动打勾。
en: Not ready yet: make the iPhone version first. This will tick itself when it's done.

en: Signed in to an Apple ID in Xcode

source: 打开 Xcode →「设置」→「账户」，点左下角「+」，登录你的 Apple ID（免费的就可以）。
en: Open Xcode → Settings → Accounts, click “+” at the bottom left, and sign in with your Apple ID (a free one works).

source: iPhone 已用数据线连上
en: iPhone connected with a cable

source: 连着不止一台 iPhone / iPad：只留要装的那一台。
en: More than one iPhone / iPad is connected. Leave only the one you want to install on.

source: 用数据线把 iPhone 连到这台 Mac，并解锁手机。
en: Connect your iPhone to this Mac with a cable and unlock it.

source: iPhone 已信任这台 Mac
en: iPhone trusts this Mac

en: On your {0}, tap Trust and enter your passcode.

en: Developer Mode is on

source: 在 {0} 上打开「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」，按提示重启；重启后解锁，这里会自动打勾。
en: On your {0}, turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode and restart when asked. After it restarts, unlock it and this will tick itself.

en: Make the iPhone version first

source: 导出
en: Export

en: Export to

en: Your library is empty

en: Choose at least one device to export to

source: 这款游戏暂不支持导出
en: This game can't be exported yet

source: 先在「设置」里放入 prod.keys
en: Add your prod.keys in Settings first

source: 这台 Mac 还缺导出要用的组件
en: This Mac is missing components needed for export

source: 正在做别的任务，做完再导出
en: Another task is running. Export when it finishes.

source: 大游戏第一次导出要几十分钟，请插上电源、别让 Mac 睡眠。
en: Large games can take tens of minutes the first time. Keep your Mac plugged in and awake.

en: Export

en: devices

en: Version

en: No DLC

en: Switch game

en: Exported before; you can export again

en: One package for both iPhone and iPad

source: 已做好，可在游戏库直接玩
en: Ready to play from your library

source: 在这台 Mac 上直接玩
en: Play on this Mac

source: 已勾选
en: Selected

source: 未勾选
en: Not selected

source: 打开导出页
en: Open Export

source: 导出到 iPhone / Mac…
en: Export to iPhone / Mac…

source: 让 AI 帮你操作
en: Let AI operate S2Arm

source: 复制给 AI 的提示词
en: Copy prompt for AI

source: 把提示词粘贴给你常用的 AI，它会按 S2Arm 内置的操作手册替你放密钥、放游戏、导出、装到 iPhone，出问题也会自己排查。你能在这个窗口里看到它的每一步。只在本机，别的设备连不进来。
en: Paste the prompt into the AI assistant you use. Following the operator manual built into S2Arm, it adds your keys and games, exports, installs on your iPhone and troubleshoots problems. You can watch every step in this window. It works only on this Mac; other devices can't connect.

source: 已复制。粘贴给你常用的 AI（Claude、ChatGPT、Codex 等）就行：它会一步步替你操作 S2Arm，遇到只能你本人做的事会停下来告诉你。
en: Copied. Paste it into the AI you use (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and so on). It operates S2Arm step by step and stops to tell you when something needs you.

source: 把提示词粘贴给你常用的 AI，它会替你做完后面的步骤，你在这个窗口里看着就行。
en: Paste the prompt into the AI you use. It does the remaining steps while you watch this window.

en: Choose the library location: it holds export working data and saves. Your game files stay where they are (choose an empty folder the first time)

source: 导入完成：游戏原件留在原处，S2Arm 只读、不复制。
en: Import finished. Your game files stay where they are; S2Arm only reads them and makes no copies.

source: 工作数据放到这台 Mac 上
en: Keep working data on this Mac

source: 好，用这台 Mac 上的默认位置
en: OK, use the default location on this Mac

en: Connect the drive that holds the game file and make sure the file is still in place and readable. If you moved it, add it again from its new location.

source: S2Arm 只读游戏原件、不改不删；同一块盘或文件夹在这台 Mac 上只需允许一次，以后升级 S2Arm 也不用再点。
en: S2Arm only reads your game files and never changes or deletes them. You allow each drive or folder once on this Mac; later S2Arm updates won't ask again.

source: 请改用64位Windows主机运行S2Arm，确认后点「重新检查」。
en: Run S2Arm on a 64-bit Windows computer, then click Recheck.

source: 检查网络后重试；还是不行就到下载页下载新版覆盖安装，当前版本和存档不受影响。
en: Check your network and try again. If it still fails, download the new version from the download page and install it over this one. Your current version and saves are not affected.

source: 之前已经装到 iPhone 上的这款可以照常接着玩。点「复制错误摘要」发给我们，修好后更新 S2Arm 再出一次包。
en: If this game is already on your iPhone, you can keep playing that copy. Click Copy error summary and send it to us; after the fix, update S2Arm and build again.

source: 这款游戏的着色器编译目前只能在 Mac 上完成，Windows 版暂不支持；请改用 Mac 版 S2Arm 出包。

source: 游戏库在云盘同步目录里（iCloud 云盘、OneDrive、Dropbox 等）：出包时会写几十 GB 中间文件，云盘会上传它们、换成占位文件，出包中途会读不到。在「设置 → 游戏库与玩家数据」把游戏库改到本机磁盘上不同步的位置（例如默认位置），再重试；游戏原件放在哪都行。
en: The game library is inside a cloud-synced folder (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and similar). Exporting writes tens of GB of intermediate files, which the cloud client uploads and replaces with placeholders, so the export cannot read them. source: 游戏原件放哪块盘都行，导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 NTFS 格式的磁盘上（FAT32 单个文件不能超过 4 GB，exFAT 没有可靠的原子替换）：在「设置 → 游戏库与玩家数据」改用这台电脑上的默认位置，或选一块 NTFS 格式的盘，再重试。
en: Game files can stay on any drive; the working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an NTFS drive (FAT32 cannot hold files over 4 GB, and exFAT has no reliable atomic replace). In Settings → Library and player data, use this PC's default location or choose an NTFS drive, then try again.

source: 已登录 Apple ID
en: Signed in with an Apple ID

source: 签名要用一个 Apple ID，免费的就行：打开 Xcode，点菜单 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts，再点 + 登录。登录好这里会自动打勾。
en: Signing needs an Apple ID, and a free one is fine. Open Xcode, choose Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts, then click + to sign in. This ticks itself once you're signed in.

source: 这款游戏的文件找不到了，请重新添加游戏文件。
en: This game's files are missing. Add them again.

source: Apple ID 团队
en: Apple ID team

source: 还没有登录 Apple ID：打开 Xcode，点菜单 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts，点 + 添加你的 Apple ID（免费的就行），选中账号，等团队列表显示出来，再回来重新检查。装了多个 Xcode 也只要登一个，账号是共用的。
en: You're not signed in to an Apple ID. Open Xcode, choose Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts, click + and add your Apple ID (a free one is fine), select it, wait for the team list to appear, then check again. With several Xcode versions, signing in to one is enough.

source: Apple ID 已经登录，但这台 Mac 还没有签名团队：点「解决办法」打开现成的引导项目，在 Xcode 里选 Personal Team，连上手机点运行一次，回来会自动打勾。也可以先到 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts 看团队列表有没有显示。
en: Your Apple ID is signed in, but this Mac has no signing team yet. Click How to fix to open the ready-made helper project, choose Personal Team in Xcode, connect your phone and run it once; this page updates by itself. You can also check whether the team list appears under Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts.

source: 找不到游戏原件：{0}。原件所在的磁盘没接上，或文件被挪走 / 改名了；接上磁盘，或把原件重新放进来一次
en: Original game file not found: {0}. Its drive is not connected, or the file was moved or renamed. Connect the drive, or add the original file again

source: 找签名账号与 iPhone
en: Finding signing account and iPhone

source: 备份这款的存档
en: Backing up saves for this game

source: 更新手机上的 S2Arm
en: Updating S2Arm on iPhone

source: 删除手机上这款的数据
en: Removing this game's data from iPhone

source: 手机上的 S2Arm 里没有这款。
en: This game is not in S2Arm on your iPhone.

source: 这是手机上最后一款：在 iPhone 桌面长按 S2Arm 删除 App 即可。
en: This is the last game on iPhone: long-press S2Arm on the home screen and delete the app instead.

source: 这台电脑没记录手机上的 S2Arm：先装一次再删。
en: No S2Arm install record on this computer: install once before removing a game.

source: App 里这款已经删了，但手机上它的数据没删掉：
en: The game was removed from the app, but its data on iPhone could not be deleted:

source: 确认后再点一次就照装：存档没备份，万一覆盖出问题可能丢档；想先备份就把手机解锁、数据线插稳后再点一次。
en: Click again to install anyway: your saves are not backed up, so a problem during the overwrite could lose them. To back them up first, unlock the phone, plug the cable in firmly, and click again.

source: 这款没法和手机上已有的游戏放进同一个 App：先从 iPhone 删掉不兼容的那款。
en: This game cannot share one app with the games already on your phone: remove the incompatible game from iPhone first.

source: 在 iPhone 桌面长按 S2Arm 删除 App 即可。
en: Touch and hold S2Arm on the iPhone Home Screen and remove the app.

source: 手机解锁、数据线插稳后再删一次；不影响其他游戏。
en: Unlock the phone, check the cable, and remove it again; other games are not affected.

source: 路径太长：把游戏库搬到盘符根目录附近的短路径（比如 D:\S2Arm），再打一次包；反馈时请带上错误摘要。
en: Path too long: move your game library to a short path near the drive root (for example D:\S2Arm), then build again. Include the error summary when reporting.

source: 检查文件和票据是否完整；若另行确认 Switch 密钥版本不足，可重新导出并到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入。
en: Check that the file and its tickets are complete. If you independently confirm your Switch keys are outdated, export them again and add them in Settings → Player keys.

source: 从原始位置重新复制完整的游戏文件，再重新导入。
en: Copy the complete game file from its original location and import it again.

source: 用系统版本更新的 Switch 重新导出 prod.keys，再到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入。
en: Export prod.keys from a Switch with newer system software, then add the file again in Settings → Player keys.

source: 游戏文件不完整，部分内容超出文件末尾。
en: The game file is incomplete. Some content extends past the end of the file.

source: 缺少内容对应的票据或标题密钥，请检查源文件是否完整。
en: The content's ticket or title key is missing. Check that the source file is complete.

source: 核对源文件是否含有所需票据。
en: Check whether the source file includes the required ticket.

source: 现有 prod.keys 缺少读取此文件所需的密钥。
en: Your prod.keys file is missing keys needed to read this file.

source: 现有 prod.keys 解不开这份文件：解出来的数据对不上，多半是这款用的那一代密钥不对。请用升级到最新系统的 Switch 重新导出 prod.keys 再导入。
en: Your current prod.keys can't decrypt this file: the decrypted data doesn't match, most likely because the key generation this game uses is wrong. Re-export prod.keys from a Switch updated to the latest system version, then import again.

source: 无法读取游戏内容：可能是文件不完整、缺票据或密钥不匹配。请核对原始文件；若已确认 Switch 密钥版本不足，再重新导出，到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入。
en: Could not read the game content. The file might be incomplete, a ticket may be missing, or the keys may not match. Check the original file. If you have confirmed the Switch keys are outdated, export them again and add them in Settings → Player keys.

source: 读不到设备列表：打开一次 Xcode，等它装完附加组件后再试。
en: Can't read the device list. Open Xcode once, wait for its additional components to install, then try again.

source: 同一网络上有多台配对过的 iPhone / iPad：用数据线连上要装的那一台。
en: Several paired iPhones / iPads are on this network. Connect the one you want to install on with a cable.

source: 读取设备列表超时：解锁手机，重新插一次数据线再试。
en: Reading the device list timed out. Unlock the phone, plug the cable in again and retry.

source: 这台 Mac 的 USB 上没看到 iPhone / iPad：换一根能传数据的线（充电线不行）、换个接口直连 Mac，并解锁手机。
en: This Mac doesn't see an iPhone / iPad on USB. Use a cable that carries data (a charge-only cable won't work), plug directly into the Mac, and unlock the phone.

source: 这台 Mac 看到手机插着，但设备服务还没列出它：解锁手机，在弹出的框里点「信任」；还不行就拔掉重插一次。
en: This Mac sees a phone plugged in, but the device service hasn't listed it yet. Unlock the phone and tap Trust. If that fails, unplug it and plug it in again.

source: 之前选的设备「{0}」现在不在，可选：{1}。用数据线只连要装的那一台再试。
en: The device you chose before, "{0}", isn't available. Available: {1}. Connect only the one you want with a cable and try again.

source: 和手机建立开发连接失败：解锁手机后再试；走无线的话换成数据线。
en: Couldn't open a development connection to the phone. Unlock it and try again. If it's on Wi-Fi, use a cable.

source: 手机的开发者服务没准备好：解锁手机后再试；还不行就重启手机。
en: The phone's developer services aren't ready. Unlock it and try again. If that fails, restart the phone.

source: iPhone 已准备好安装
en: iPhone is ready to install

source: 正在请手机信任这台 Mac
en: Asking the phone to trust this Mac

source: 正在和手机建立开发连接
en: Opening a development connection to the phone

source: 正在准备手机的开发者服务
en: Preparing the phone's developer services

source: 手机还没准备好
en: iPhone isn't ready

source: 按上面的提示做完，再点一次安装。
en: Follow the steps above, then tap Install again.

source: 原来的位置不是可搬的游戏库。
en: The current location isn't a library that can be moved.

source: 新位置不能在原来的游戏库里面，也不能包含它。
en: The new location can't be inside the current library or contain it.

source: 旧游戏库还有任务在跑，等它结束再搬。
en: A task is still running in the current library. Wait for it to finish, then move.

source: 新位置空间不够，游戏库没有搬。
en: Not enough space at the new location. The library wasn't moved.

source: 拷到新位置后校验不一致：{0}
en: Verification failed after copying to the new location: {0}

source: 把游戏库拷到新位置
en: Copying the library to the new location

source: 把游戏库放到新位置
en: Placing the library at the new location

source: 游戏库已经搬好，旧位置有文件没删掉，可以手动删除：{0}
en: The library has moved, but some files at the old location couldn't be deleted. You can delete them yourself: {0}

source: 这个文件夹里已有别的文件：请选空文件夹，或者已有的 S2Arm 游戏库。文件都没动。
en: This folder already has other files. Choose an empty folder or an existing S2Arm library. Nothing was changed.

source: 游戏库还在原来的位置，什么都没有丢：按上面的原因处理后再搬一次。
en: The library is still where it was and nothing was lost. Fix the problem above and move it again.

source: 游戏库没有搬成
en: Library wasn't moved

source: 「{0}」已从游戏库删除，新版 S2Arm 里不再包含它们；手机上的存档还在。
en: "{0}" was removed from the library, so the new S2Arm no longer includes it. Its saves stay on the phone.

source: 这款游戏没有可用的 60 帧方案。
en: No 60 FPS option is available for this game.

source: 没有可以装回的上一版手机 S2Arm。
en: There's no previous S2Arm to restore on iPhone.

source: 装回上一版 S2Arm
en: Restoring the previous S2Arm

source: 记下手机上现在的版本
en: Recording the version now on iPhone

source: 这款暂时打不了包，换一款官方游戏试试；如果确定是正版游戏，点「复制错误摘要」发给我们。
en: This game can't be packaged yet. Try an official game; if you are sure this is a retail game, click "Copy error summary" and send it to us.

source: 这款还没适配，点「复制错误摘要」发给我们，我们按它补上。
en: This game isn't supported yet. Click "Copy error summary" and send it to us, and we'll add support.

source: 正在传输资源
en: Transferring resources

source: 苹果拒绝注册这个包名（Apple 错误 9401：同一个包名在苹果那边已被占用）。请在 Impactor（Mac 上是 Xcode）里确认登录的是当初装 S2Arm 用的那个 Apple ID 再装；付费开发者账号也可以到 developer.apple.com 的「Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Identifiers」删掉 io.s2arm.games 开头的旧包名后重试。还不行请导出诊断包反馈。
en: Apple refused to register this App ID (Apple error 9401: the identifier is already taken on Apple's side). In Impactor (Xcode on a Mac), make sure you are signed in with the Apple ID you first installed S2Arm with, then install again. With a paid developer account you can also delete the old identifier starting with io.s2arm.games under "Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles > Identifiers" on developer.apple.com and try again. If it still fails, export a diagnostics package and report it.

source: 机上有推完、还没解开的推送包 {0} 个：其中 {1} 个文件算已推，不重推
en: {0} pushed-but-not-unpacked batch(es) are already on the phone; {1} files count as pushed and are not resent

source: 起一次 App 解开推送包（S2A_PACK_APPLY_ONLY=1）
en: Launching the app once to unpack the pushed batch (S2A_PACK_APPLY_ONLY=1)

source: 资源包：机上已解开（.applied = 本包）
en: Pack: unpacked on the phone (.applied = this pack)

source: 资源包：机上实况与已应用索引不符：{0} 拉不回或 sha256 不对
en: Pack: the phone's state does not match the applied index: {0} could not be read back or has a wrong sha256

source: 资源包：抽查 {0} 个、{1} 个不符，机上清单拉不回，不信已应用索引，整包重推
en: Pack: spot-checked {0} files, {1} mismatched, the on-device manifest could not be read back, so the applied index is not trusted and the whole pack is pushed again

source: 把这款放进手机上的 S2Arm
en: Put this game into S2Arm on the phone

source: 签名并装到 iPhone（Impactor 官方命令行 plumesign）
en: Sign and install on the iPhone (Impactor's official command line, plumesign)

source: 保存游戏名字和封面
en: Save the game name and cover

source: 把这款游戏搬到新的存放位置
en: Move this game to its new location

source: 【红】测试设备剩余空间不足：可写 {0} GB < 要 {1} GB（待推 {2} GB + 解开时最大一批 + 余量）；先卸掉机上不用的包
en: [red] The device does not have enough free space: writable {0} GB < needed {1} GB ({2} GB to push + the largest unpack batch + margin); remove packages you do not need from the device first
Seeding: {0} s (rc={1})

source: 格式通过，首次读取游戏时验证解密能力
en: Format OK; decryption is verified the first time the game is read

source: 签名工具 Impactor 已就绪（随 S2Arm 附带的第三方开源工具）
en: Signing tool Impactor is ready (the third-party open-source tool bundled with S2Arm)

source: 已在 Impactor 里登录 Apple ID（只需一次）
en: Signed in to an Apple ID in Impactor (only needed once)

source: 点「打开 Impactor」，在「设置 → 添加账号」登录你的 Apple ID（免费的就行），登录好回来这里自动打勾。
en: Click "Open Impactor", sign in to your Apple ID under "Settings > Add account" (a free one is fine), then come back here; it ticks automatically once you are signed in.

source: 重新输入导出 .p12 时设的密码（区分大小写）；还不行就重新导出一份 .p12 再导入。
en: Re-enter the password you set when exporting the .p12 (it is case-sensitive). If it still fails, export a new .p12 and import it again.

source: 选导出的 .p12 证书和开发者网站下载的 .mobileprovision 描述文件，再导入一次。
en: Choose the exported .p12 certificate and the .mobileprovision profile downloaded from the developer website, then import again.

source: 在开发者网站重新生成描述文件并勾上这张证书，下载后和证书一起重新导入。
en: Regenerate the provisioning profile on the developer website with this certificate selected, download it, and import it together with the certificate.

source: 在出包页「我的开发者证书」里重新导入证书和描述文件，或切回「Apple ID 签名」。
en: Import the certificate and profile again under “My developer certificate” on the export page, or switch back to “Apple ID signing”.

source: 解锁登录钥匙串并允许 S2Arm 访问后，重新导入证书。
en: Unlock your login keychain, allow S2Arm to access it, then import the certificate again.

source: 找不到签名工具 rcodesign：请重新安装完整的 S2Arm。
en: The signing tool rcodesign is missing. Reinstall the complete S2Arm.

source: 描述文件读不出来：选的不是 .mobileprovision，或文件坏了。
en: Can't read the provisioning profile: the file isn't a .mobileprovision, or it's damaged.

source: 描述文件里没有权限表：选的不是 iOS 描述文件。
en: The profile has no entitlements: it isn't an iOS provisioning profile.

source: 证书打不开：密码不对，或 .p12 文件坏了。
en: Can't open the certificate: the password is wrong, or the .p12 file is damaged.

source: 证书打不开：.p12 里没有证书。
en: Can't open the certificate: the .p12 contains no certificate.

source: 证书和描述文件不配套：这份描述文件里没有这张证书，签出来装不上。请在开发者网站重新生成包含这张证书的描述文件。
en: The certificate and profile don't match: this profile doesn't include the certificate, so a signed app won't install. Regenerate a profile that includes this certificate on the developer website.

source: 提高内存上限、扩展寻址
en: Increased Memory Limit, Extended Virtual Addressing

source: 证书已于 {0} 过期：签出来的 App 装不上或打不开，请换新的证书。
en: The certificate expired on {0}. Signed apps won't install or open; replace the certificate.

source: 描述文件已于 {0} 过期：签出来的 App 装不上或打不开，请换新的描述文件。
en: The profile expired on {0}. Signed apps won't install or open; replace the profile.

source: 证书将于 {0} 到期（还剩 {1} 天）：到期后 App 打不开，记得提前换新。
en: The certificate expires on {0} ({1} days left). The app won't open after that, so renew it in time.

source: 描述文件将于 {0} 到期（还剩 {1} 天）：到期后 App 打不开，记得提前换新。
en: The profile expires on {0} ({1} days left). The app won't open after that, so renew it in time.

source: 连着的这台 iPhone 不在描述文件的设备列表里：签出来装不上这台。请在开发者网站登记这台设备并重新生成描述文件。
en: The connected iPhone isn't in the profile's device list, so a signed app won't install on it. Register this device on the developer website and regenerate the profile.

source: 证书密码没存进钥匙串：{0}
en: Couldn't save the certificate password to the keychain: {0}

source: 开发者证书不完整（证书、描述文件或密码缺了）：在出包页重新导入一次。
en: The developer certificate is incomplete (certificate, profile, or password missing). Import it again on the export page.

source: 钥匙串在这个会话里读不了（ssh 等没有图形界面的会话里登录钥匙串是锁的）：请在这台 Mac 的图形会话里运行，或先解锁登录钥匙串。
en: The keychain can't be read in this session (the login keychain stays locked in sessions without a graphical login, such as ssh). Run this from a graphical session on this Mac, or unlock the login keychain first.

source: 没收到证书密码。
en: No certificate password was received.

source: 找不到 .p12 证书：{0}
en: Can't find the .p12 certificate: {0}

source: 找不到 .mobileprovision 描述文件：{0}
en: Can't find the .mobileprovision profile: {0}

source: 还没导入开发者证书。
en: No developer certificate has been imported yet.

source: 不支持的证书操作。
en: Unsupported certificate operation.

source: 开发者证书可用
en: Developer certificate is usable

source: 这台 iPhone 在描述文件的设备列表里
en: This iPhone is in the profile's device list

source: 不在列表里：签出来装不上这台。请在开发者网站登记这台设备并重新生成描述文件，再在出包页重新导入。
en: Not in the list, so a signed app won't install on it. Register this device on the developer website, regenerate the profile, then import it again on the export page.

source: 读取证书与描述文件
en: Reading certificate and profile

source: 保存证书
en: Saving certificate

source: 用你的开发者证书签名
en: Signing with your developer certificate

source: 无法安全读取或写入诊断文件，未更新诊断包（{0}：{1}）。
en: Couldn't safely read or write the diagnostics files, so the diagnostics package was not updated ({0}: {1}).

source: 打开日志目录
en: opening the log folder

source: 在所选位置建临时文件
en: creating a temporary file in the chosen location

source: 读日志与任务记录
en: reading logs and task records

source: 把诊断包放到所选位置
en: moving the package to the chosen location

source: 游戏库里已经没有这款游戏
en: This game is no longer in your library

source: 这台电脑出不了这个平台的包
en: This computer cannot build for this platform

source: 游戏照常能玩，只是开头几次进新场景会卡一下（着色器现编，编过的会记住）。请导出诊断反馈给我们，修好后重新出包就能提前编好。
en: The game still runs; it just stutters briefly the first few times it reaches a new scene (shaders compile on first use and are remembered). Please export diagnostics and send them to us; after the fix, packaging again prebuilds them.

source: 没说要装到哪台设备：在装机页选好 iPhone / iPad 再装。
en: No device chosen: choose an iPhone or iPad on the install page, then install.

source: {0}「{1}」现在不在线：插上数据线，或让它和这台电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi 并解锁，再试一次。
en: {0} “{1}” is offline: plug it in with a cable, or unlock it on the same Wi-Fi as this computer, then try again.

source: 要装的那台设备（编号末尾 {0}）现在不在线：插上数据线并解锁，或让它和这台电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi，再试一次。
en: The chosen device (ID ending {0}) is offline: plug it in and unlock it, or put it on the same Wi-Fi as this computer, then try again.

source: 要装的那台设备（编号末尾 {0}）现在不在线：插上数据线并解锁，或让它和这台电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi。
en: The chosen device (ID ending {0}) is offline: plug it in and unlock it, or put it on the same Wi-Fi as this computer.

source: 读不出{0}上已经装了哪些游戏，为免把别的游戏挤掉，这次没装：把它解锁，插上数据线或和这台电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi，再点一次。
en: Couldn't read which games are already on {0}, so nothing was installed to avoid pushing other games out: unlock it, plug it in or put it on the same Wi-Fi as this computer, then try again.
{0} “{1}” connected ({2})
{0} connected ({1})

source: 数据线
en: cable

source: 同一 Wi-Fi
en: same Wi-Fi

source: 设备
en: Device

source: 选的设备已连上（数据线或同一 Wi-Fi）
en: Chosen device connected (cable or same Wi-Fi)

source: {0} 已信任这台 Mac
en: {0} trusts this Mac

source: {0} 已打开开发者模式
en: Developer Mode is on

source: {0} 已准备好安装
en: {0} is ready to install

source: 用数据线把 iPhone / iPad 连到这台电脑，或让它和这台电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi；解锁并点「信任」。
en: Connect the iPhone or iPad to this computer with a cable, or put it on the same Wi-Fi; unlock it and tap Trust.

source: 等正在用游戏库的那个任务结束（或在任务列表里取消它）再重试；什么都没有改动。
en: Wait for the task that is using the library to finish (or cancel it in the task list), then try again. Nothing was changed.

source: 原任务进程已不在，但游戏库的锁仍被占用。重新连接或重新挂载游戏库所在磁盘后再试；不要手动删除锁文件。本次没有改动游戏文件。
en: The original task process is gone, but the library lock is still held. Reconnect or remount the library drive and retry. Do not delete the lock file; no game files were changed.

source: 游戏存放位置或游戏库所在的盘不支持 S2Arm 需要的文件操作（常见于 exFAT / FAT 格式的外接盘）：把这款游戏的存放位置换到 APFS 格式的盘（Mac 内置盘就是；外接盘可在「磁盘工具」里另分一个 APFS 分区），再重试；游戏原件不用挪。
en: The drive holding this game's storage location or the game library doesn't support the file operations S2Arm needs (common on exFAT / FAT external drives). Move this game's storage location to an APFS drive (the Mac's built-in drive is APFS; on an external drive you can add an APFS partition in Disk Utility), then try again. The original game files can stay where they are.

source: 存放位置所在磁盘格式不支持：这块盘不支持出包需要的文件操作（常见于 exFAT / FAT 格式的外接盘）。
en: Drive format not supported: this drive doesn't support the file operations exporting needs (common on exFAT / FAT external drives).

source: 批次记录（数据目录下的 batch.json）写不进：检查数据目录所在磁盘的空间与权限，处理后在批量出包页点「继续」；已出好的包都在。
en: The batch record (batch.json in the data folder) couldn't be written: check free space and permissions on that disk, then click "Continue" on the batch export page. Finished games are kept.

source: 批次记录没写成（batch.json：{0}）：这一批停在这里，已出好的不受影响。
en: The batch record wasn't saved (batch.json: {0}). The batch stopped here; finished games are kept.

source: 批次文件不见了或读不出（batch.json）：这一批停在这里，已出好的不受影响。
en: The batch file (batch.json) is missing or unreadable. The batch stopped here; finished games are kept.

source: 已经有一个出包在进行：等它出完或取消后再出。
en: Another export is already running. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it, then try again.

source: 没有进行中的批次：先在批量出包页建好这一批。
en: There's no batch in progress. Set one up on the batch export page first.

source: 磁盘空间不足，这一批暂停了：释放空间后点「重试」接着出，已出好的不受影响。
en: Not enough disk space, so the batch is paused. Free up space, then click "Retry" to continue. Finished games are kept.

source: 这一步的出包作业没有给出结局就退出了（详见这一步的日志）。
en: This export step exited without reporting a result (see this step's log).
Exporting {0} ({1})

source: 出包计划不完整：plan.source 只认 inline / batch。
en: The export plan is incomplete: plan.source must be inline or batch.

source: 启动器退出了，这一批停在第 {0} 款：重开启动器后点「继续剩下的」，只出还没出的。
en: The launcher was closed, so the batch stopped at game {0}. Reopen the launcher and click "Continue the rest" to export only what's left.

source: 在等「{0}」结束…
en: Waiting for “{0}” to finish…

source: 再启动一次试试；还是这样，就在「环境检查」导出诊断包，到 GitHub 发帖附上，我们按崩溃现场修。
en: Try starting it again. If it happens again, export a diagnostics package from Environment Check and attach it to a GitHub issue so we can fix the crash.

source: 没找到要装的那台设备（{0}）：它还没和这台电脑配对过——插上数据线并解锁，在设备上点「信任」（配对过以后也可以连同一个 Wi-Fi 装）。
en: The chosen device ({0}) hasn't been paired with this computer yet: plug it in, unlock it and tap Trust on the device (after that it can also install over the same Wi-Fi).

source: 清出空间后点「重试」。
en: Free up some space, then tap Retry.

source: 更新 iPhone 上的 S2Arm，再打开这款游戏。
en: Update S2Arm on the iPhone, then open the game again.

source: 从电脑重新装到 iPhone，会接着已传的部分续传。
en: Install to iPhone from the computer again; it resumes from what was already sent.

source: 重新连电脑推送，会自动补齐。
en: Connect to the computer and push again; the missing part is filled in automatically.

source: 从电脑重新装到 iPhone。
en: Install to iPhone from the computer again.

source: 重新打开 S2Arm 后点「重试」；还不行就导出诊断包发给我们。
en: Reopen S2Arm and tap Retry. If it still fails, export a diagnostics package and send it to us.

source: 检查文件是否拷完整，再打开 S2Arm。
en: Check that the file was copied completely, then open S2Arm again.

source: 导出诊断包发给我们。
en: Export a diagnostics package and send it to us.

source: 这个包名之前被别的签名用过（多半是你自己签名装 S2Arm 时用了同一个包名），这次已自动换成新包名装好。手机上可能有两个 S2Arm：新装的这个里有这台电脑装的游戏；旧的那个不再需要的话可以删掉（先导出存档）。
en: This app ID was already used by another signature (most likely when you signed S2Arm yourself with the same app ID), so it was installed under a new app ID automatically. You may see two S2Arm apps on your iPhone: the new one has the games from this computer; delete the old one if you no longer need it (export its saves first).

source: iPhone 通过同一网络连着（没插数据线）
en: iPhone connected over the same network (no cable)

source: 能装，但网络传资源包慢、容易断：插上数据线再装更稳。
en: Installing works, but sending game data over the network is slow and can drop. Plug in a cable for a steadier install.

source: 电脑内存不够：出包时内存用完了。
en: Not enough memory: this computer ran out of memory while exporting.

source: 关掉其它占内存的程序（浏览器、游戏等）后重试；还不行就在 Windows 设置里调大虚拟内存（页面文件），或换一台内存更大的电脑出包。已做完的步骤下次会复用。
en: Close other memory-heavy apps (browsers, games, etc.) and try again. If it still fails, increase virtual memory (the page file) in Windows settings, or export on a computer with more memory. Finished steps are reused next time.

source: 游戏库在 Mac OS 扩展（HFS+）格式的磁盘上：可以出包，但这种盘不能克隆，出包会多占一份资源包的空间。
en: The library is on a Mac OS Extended (HFS+) drive. Exporting works, but this drive can't clone files, so exports take an extra copy of the resources' space.

source: 先给点名的游戏各「打 iPhone 包」一次，再装到 iPhone；也可以确认后这次先不带它们照装，它们的存档和资源留在手机上，重新出包再装就回来。
en: Run "Build for iPhone" once for each game named, then install on iPhone. Or confirm to install without them this time: their saves and resources stay on the phone, and they come back once you rebuild and install them.

source: 这款游戏暂不支持：出包工具还没适配这款游戏的程序结构。请把诊断发给我们，我们按它补上。
en: This game is not supported yet. The packer doesn't handle how this game's program is built yet. Please send us a diagnostic and we'll add support.

source: 可以点「仍然用这里」照用这块盘（出包会多占空间）；想省空间就从下面列出的 NTFS 盘里选一块，点「放到这里」。
en: Choose "Use this drive anyway" to keep using this drive (exports take more space), or pick one of the NTFS drives listed below and choose "Use this drive" to save space.

source: 在出包页「存放位置」换到 NTFS 格式的盘（上面列出了这台电脑上可用的），再出包；游戏原件放在哪都行。
en: On the export page, change Storage Location to an NTFS drive (the available ones on this PC are listed above), then export again. Your game files can stay wherever they are.

source: 游戏库在 EXFAT 格式的磁盘上（支持出包）。
en: The library is on an EXFAT drive (supported for packaging).

source: 格式的磁盘上。游戏原件放在这里没问题：放游戏时直接选它们，S2Arm 只读、不复制也不改。导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 APFS 或 exFAT 格式的磁盘上，会放到这台 Mac 上的默认位置。想把工作数据也放外接盘，请选一块 APFS / exFAT 盘（FAT32 单文件有 4 GB 上限，不适合做游戏库）。
en: . Your game files can stay here: pick them when adding games, and S2Arm only reads them without copying or changing them. The working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an APFS or exFAT drive, so it goes to the default location on this Mac. To keep working data on an external drive too, choose an APFS or exFAT disk (FAT32 has a 4 GB file-size limit and is not suitable for the library).

source: 游戏库放导出时的工作数据和存档，要在 APFS 或 exFAT 格式的磁盘上；游戏原件留在原处（哪块盘都行），S2Arm 只读、不复制。
en: The library holds export working data and saves and must be on an APFS or exFAT drive. Game files stay where they are (any drive); S2Arm only reads them and makes no copies.

source: 游戏原件放哪块盘都行，导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 APFS 或 exFAT 格式的磁盘上：在「设置 → 游戏库与玩家数据」改用这台 Mac 上的默认位置（内置盘），或选一块 APFS / exFAT 外接盘，再重试；FAT32 等格式不适合做游戏库。游戏原件不用挪。
en: Game files can be on any drive, but the working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an APFS or exFAT drive. In Settings → Library & Player Data, switch to the default location on this Mac (built-in drive), or choose an APFS / exFAT external drive, then try again. FAT32 and similar formats are not suitable for the library. Your game files don't need to move.

source: 选的文件夹里已有别的文件：确认「仍然继续」就照用这个文件夹，S2Arm 只在自己建的文件和子文件夹里读写，不改也不删它们；不想这样就选一个空文件夹。
en: This folder already has other files. Choose Continue Anyway to use it: S2Arm only reads and writes the files and subfolders it creates, and never changes or deletes the others. Otherwise choose an empty folder.

source: 这个文件夹里已有别的文件。S2Arm 只在自己建的文件和子文件夹里读写，不改也不删它们；以后「搬游戏库」时它们会跟着一起搬到新位置。仍要用这个文件夹吗？不想这样就选一个空文件夹。
en: This folder already has other files. S2Arm only reads and writes the files and subfolders it creates, and never changes or deletes them; if you move the library later, they move with it. Use this folder anyway? Otherwise choose an empty folder.

source: 资源传输中断（{0}）：{1} 没传完，重新装到 iPhone 会接着已传的部分续传
en: Resource transfer interrupted ({0}): {1} was not fully copied. Installing to the iPhone again resumes from what was already copied.

source: 资源传输中断（{0}）：{1} 没传完。这款是旧版本出的包，断了只能从头传。新版已支持单一文件包和断点续传：在启动器里重新出一次这款的包，以后断了能接着传。
en: Resource transfer interrupted ({0}): {1} was not fully copied. This game's package was made by an older version, so an interrupted transfer has to start over. The new version supports single-file packages and resumable transfers: build this game's package again in the launcher, and an interrupted transfer will pick up where it left off.

source: USB 看不到手机（没插数据线，或手机只在无线连接上）
en: The phone is not visible over USB (no cable, or the phone is only connected wirelessly)

source: 手机锁屏了
en: The phone is locked

source: 和手机的连接断了（数据线松了 / Wi-Fi 断开）
en: The connection to the phone dropped (loose cable or Wi-Fi disconnected)

source: 深度优化方案
en: Optimized port

source: 更改
en: Change

source: 这个下游方案只支持某一版更新（上面写了是哪一版）：导入那一版更新后再导出；不换更新就在确认页选「仍用原版方案」。
en: This downstream route supports one update version only (named above): import that update and export again; to keep your update, choose "Keep the standard route" on the confirmation page.

source: 检查这台电脑的网络（能打开 s2arm.com）后再点一次；下了一半的不会被当成好的用。
en: Check this computer's network (that s2arm.com opens) and click again; a partial download is never used as a good one.

source: 用原版游戏文件重新导入这款：先在游戏库里移除它，再把原版文件拖进来。
en: Re-import this game from the original game files: remove it from the library first, then drag the original files in.

source: 进程卡在系统内核里还没退出（多为内存不够时等换页）；等它自行结束后再开，关掉其他占内存的程序可减少再次卡住。
en: The process is stuck in the system kernel and has not exited yet (usually waiting on paging when memory is short). Wait for it to end on its own before starting again; closing other memory-heavy apps makes it less likely to happen again.

source: 本款满屏有已知问题，暂不可开。
en: Full screen has a known problem in this game and can't be turned on yet.

source: 已生效：上一局实测 {0} 帧
en: Applied: {0} FPS measured last session

source: 已生效：上一局画面比例 {0}
en: Applied: {0} picture last session

source: 没生效：补丁与这个版本的游戏不配套
en: Not applied: doesn't match this version of the game

source: 开着，但上一局实测只有 {0} 帧
en: On, but only {0} FPS measured last session

source: 已生效：上一局画面铺满
en: Applied: the picture filled the screen last session

source: 开着，但上一局画面没铺满
en: On, but the picture did not fill the screen last session

source: 整理 iPhone 版程序与资源包
en: Prepare the iPhone app and resources

source: 编出 iPhone / iPad 版程序、打好资源包；出完接着导出成未签名的 S2Arm.ipa 和这款的 .img，你用自签工具安装。
en: Builds the iPhone / iPad app and packs the resources, then exports an unsigned S2Arm.ipa and this game's .img for you to install with your signing tool.

source: 把游戏资源推进 iPhone（只推变了的文件；第一次要几分钟）
en: Sending game resources to iPhone (only changed files; the first time takes a few minutes)

source: 要装的那台设备（编号末尾 {0}）这次没列出来，这台电脑现在连着 {1} 台：在装机页选其中一台再装。
en: The chosen device (ID ending {0}) isn't listed right now; this computer is connected to {1} devices. Pick one of them on the install page and install again.

source: 这台电脑的设备服务里没看到 iPhone / iPad：插上数据线并解锁手机，在手机上点「信任」，再试一次。
en: This computer's device service doesn't see an iPhone or iPad: plug it in with a cable, unlock it, tap Trust on the device, then try again.

source: 要装的那台（{0}）这次没列出来；这台电脑现在看得到：{1}——在装机页选其中一台再装。
en: The chosen device ({0}) isn't listed right now. This computer can see: {1}. Pick one of them on the install page and install again.

source: 先把导出文件夹里这款的完整 .img（不带「着色器更新包」字样的那个）放进「放这里导入」，导好后再放更新包。
en: Put this game's full .img from the export folder (the one without "shader update" in its name) into Import Here first, then add the update.

source: 把电脑上这次导出的完整 .img 放进「放这里导入」重新导一遍（游戏版本换过，只换着色器套不上）。
en: Put the full .img from this export on your computer into Import Here and import it again (the game version changed, so a shader-only update can't be applied).

source: 手机上有几款游戏这次放不进同一个 App。
en: Some games on the phone can't go into the same app this time.

source: 这台电脑上没有它们的 iPhone 版：{0}
en: This computer has no iPhone build of: {0}

source: 它们是旧版 S2Arm 出的 iPhone 版，新版认不得，要重新「打 iPhone 包」：{0}
en: Built for iPhone by an older S2Arm, which this version can't use. Run "Build for iPhone" again for: {0}

source: 确认继续的话，这次先不带它们照装，它们的存档和资源都留在手机上，之后给它们「打 iPhone 包」再装一次就回来。同意一次后，这台手机在这一版 S2Arm 上不再为它们问。
en: Confirm to install without them this time. Their saves and resources stay on the phone, and they come back once you build them for iPhone and install again. After you agree once, this phone won't ask about them again on this S2Arm version.

source: 免费个人开发者团队签不了这个 App 申请的某项权限（例如「扩展虚拟寻址」）；更新 S2Arm 后重新安装（新版对免费团队只申请能签的权限），或在 Xcode 改用付费开发者团队。
en: A free personal development team cannot sign a capability this app requests (such as Extended Virtual Addressing). Update S2Arm and install again (the new version requests only what a free team can sign), or switch to a paid development team in Xcode.

source: 直接再出一次包：对不上的文件会重新读、重新算，不用重新导入游戏。还是这样就检查一下游戏库所在的磁盘（Windows：磁盘属性 →「工具」→「检查」），并关掉对游戏库文件夹的杀毒实时扫描或云同步，或把游戏库换到另一块盘。
en: Package again: the files that didn't match will be read and computed again, and you don't need to import the game again. If it still happens, check the disk the game library is on (Windows: disk Properties → Tools → Check), turn off antivirus real-time scanning or cloud sync for the game library folder, or move the game library to another disk.

source: 资源包核对没通过：出包最后核对资源包时，有文件前后两次读出的内容对不上。多见于磁盘或内存读写不稳定，或有杀毒、云同步软件在改游戏库里的文件。
en: Resource pack check failed: When checking the resource pack at the end of packaging, some files read back differently from before. This usually means unstable disk or memory reads, or antivirus or cloud sync software changing files in the game library.

source: 这次装完，手机上这几款游戏会打不开（存档和资源包都还在手机上）。
en: After this install, these games on the phone won't open (their saves and resources stay on the phone).

source: 它们已从这台电脑的游戏库删除，重新加回游戏库、「打 iPhone 包」再装一次就回来：{0}
en: Deleted from this computer's library; they come back once you add them again, "Build for iPhone" and install: {0}

source: 确认继续再点一次。
en: Confirm and try again to continue.

source: 关掉打开着这个文件夹的资源管理器窗口和自签工具（如 Sideloadly），稍等杀毒软件扫完再重试；若开了「受控文件夹访问」（Windows 安全中心 → 病毒和威胁防护 → 勒索软件防护），把 S2Arm 加进「允许的应用」。
en: Close any File Explorer window and sideloading tool (such as Sideloadly) that has this folder open, wait for your antivirus to finish scanning, then try again. If Controlled folder access is on (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Ransomware protection), add S2Arm to the allowed apps.

source: 关掉正在使用这个游戏文件的程序再重试；若开了「受控文件夹访问」（Windows 安全中心 → 病毒和威胁防护 → 勒索软件防护），把 S2Arm 加进「允许的应用」，或把游戏文件拷到别的文件夹后重新导入。
en: Close any program using this game file and try again. If Controlled folder access is on (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Ransomware protection), add S2Arm to the allowed apps, or copy the game file to another folder and import it again.

source: 原来的导出文件夹正被别的程序占用，这次导出到新文件夹：{0}
en: The old export folder is in use by another program, so this export went to a new folder: {0}

source: 用新文件夹里的 S2Arm.ipa 和 .img 自签安装；关掉占用旧文件夹的程序后，可以把旧的那个删掉。
en: Sideload with the S2Arm.ipa and .img files in the new folder. After closing the program using the old folder, you can delete the old one.

source: 系统不让 S2Arm 往游戏库所在的磁盘写（{0}）
en: The system did not let S2Arm write to the drive holding the library ({0})

source: 选的是游戏文件，不是密钥：这里要的是 prod.keys 文本文件（通常几十 KB）；游戏请从「添加游戏」导入。
en: That's a game file, not your keys. This needs the prod.keys text file (usually a few dozen KB); add games with "Add games" instead.

source: 下不了 Metal 组件：连不上苹果的组件服务器，Metal 编译组件下载不下来。
en: Can't download Metal. Apple's component server can't be reached, so the Metal compiler component can't be downloaded.

source: 连不上苹果的组件服务器：检查网络，关掉或换个代理后在设置里再点「一键下载」；还不行就从苹果开发者网站下载与你的 Xcode 配套的 Metal Toolchain（.dmg），在「终端」运行 xcodebuild -importComponent MetalToolchain -importPath <下载的 .dmg>，回来点「重新检查」。
en: Can't reach Apple's component server: check your network, turn off or switch your proxy, then click Download in Settings again. If it still fails, download the Metal Toolchain (.dmg) matching your Xcode from Apple's developer website, run xcodebuild -importComponent MetalToolchain -importPath <the .dmg> in Terminal, then click Recheck.

source: 导出诊断包，手动发到 GitHub 帖子或群里；网络恢复后也可以再点一次「故障报修」。
en: Export the diagnostics package and post it to the GitHub issue or group yourself; once the network is back you can also click "Report a problem" again.

source: 没有能出的游戏
en: No games can be built

source: 正在出包
en: A build is already running

source: 批次清单组不出来
en: Could not put the batch list together

source: 批次脚本起不来
en: The batch script did not start

source: 建批次失败
en: Could not create the batch

source: 批次脚本没有回应
en: The batch script did not respond

source: 没有勾选要删除的项。
