source: Apple TV 版要付费的 Apple 开发者账号：tvOS 上「提高内存上限」和「扩展虚拟寻址」两项权限只有付费开发者账号签得了，免费账号签出来会被系统丢掉、大游戏开不了。在 Xcode 的「设置 → 账户」里登录付费开发者账号（或在团队里选付费团队），再装一次。
en: The Apple TV version needs a paid Apple Developer account: on tvOS, the Increased Memory Limit and Extended Virtual Addressing capabilities can only be signed by a paid developer account; a free account's signature has them dropped by the system and large games won't open. Sign in to a paid developer account in Xcode Settings → Accounts (or pick a paid team), then install again.

source: 申请 Apple TV 开发描述文件（第一次要几十秒）
en: Requesting the Apple TV development provisioning profile (the first time takes tens of seconds)

source: 找签名账号与 Apple TV
en: Finding the signing account and Apple TV

source: 把这款放进 Apple TV 上的 S2Arm
en: Adding this game to S2Arm on the Apple TV

source: 这台电脑上还没有 Apple TV 版的预编壳：先给这款出一次 Apple TV 包，再装到 Apple TV。
en: This computer doesn't have the prebuilt Apple TV shell yet: build this game for Apple TV once, then install on Apple TV.

source: 这款的 Apple TV 版不是这一版 S2Arm 出的（或还没出）：先出 Apple TV 包，再装到 Apple TV。
en: This game's Apple TV build wasn't made by this version of S2Arm (or hasn't been made yet): build it for Apple TV first, then install on Apple TV.

source: 这个 S2Arm 安装包没带 Apple TV 预编壳，这台电脑出不了 Apple TV 包：请更新到带 Apple TV 支持的 S2Arm 版本。
en: This S2Arm installation doesn't include the Apple TV shell, so this computer can't build Apple TV versions. Update to an S2Arm version with Apple TV support.

source: 这个 S2Arm 安装包不完整（缺 Apple TV 签名权限文件），请重新下载 S2Arm。
en: This S2Arm installation is incomplete (the Apple TV signing entitlements file is missing). Download S2Arm again.

source: 这款游戏还没出 Apple TV 包：先在出包页勾上「Apple TV」出一次包。
en: This game hasn't been built for Apple TV yet: tick Apple TV on the build page and build it once.

source: 没找到这款的 Apple TV 资源包（{0}），没有装。请重新出 Apple TV 包后再装。
en: Couldn't find this game's Apple TV resource pack ({0}), so nothing was installed. Build it for Apple TV again, then install.

source: 装到 Apple TV
en: Install on Apple TV

source: iPhone 版没出好，Apple TV 包从它派生：先看上面 iPhone 那一步的报错。
en: The iPhone build didn't finish, and the Apple TV build is derived from it: check the iPhone step's error above.

source: 把贴图预转成 Apple TV 能直接用的格式（BC → ASTC，只做一次）
en: Converting textures to a format the Apple TV can use directly (BC → ASTC, done once)

source: 这款没有 RomFS，Apple TV 包不用预转贴图
en: This game has no RomFS, so no texture conversion is needed for Apple TV

source: 「{0}」里没找到 mod：资源替换要带 romfs/（如 atmosphere/contents/{0}/romfs），代码补丁要带 exefs/ 里的 pchtxt / IPS（或 atmosphere/exefs_patches/<名字>/）。
en: No mod found in "{0}": asset mods need a romfs/ folder (for example atmosphere/contents/{0}/romfs); code mods need pchtxt / IPS files in exefs/ (or atmosphere/exefs_patches/<name>/).

source: 「{0}」是整份替换游戏程序的 mod，S2Arm 不支持：S2Arm 出包时要改写游戏程序，只能把 exefs/ 里的 pchtxt / IPS 补丁编进去；资源替换类（romfs/）照常能用。
en: "{0}" replaces the whole game program, which S2Arm does not support: S2Arm rewrites the game program when packing, so only pchtxt / IPS patches in exefs/ can be built in. Asset mods (romfs/) still work.

source: 「{0}」是空的，没收
en: "{0}" is empty, skipped

source: 「{0}」带 {0} 份代码补丁：重新打包这款（或 S 级优化升级）后生效
en: "{0}" includes {0} code patch(es): they take effect after you re-pack this game (or run the S-grade upgrade)

source: 在游戏库里长按这款，选「删除游戏…」，再把电脑上导出的这款 .img 重新放进「放这里导入」。
en: In the library, press and hold this game and choose “Delete game…”, then put this game's .img exported on the computer into Import Here again.

source: 读不到 Impactor 当前选中的 Apple ID：在 Impactor 里登录并选中你的 Apple ID 后再装。
en: Can't read the Apple ID selected in Impactor: sign in to Impactor, select your Apple ID, then install again.

source: 写进 App 要申请的权限
en: Adding the permissions the app requests

source: 下游方案只能装到 iPhone
en: This port can only be installed on iPhone

source: 这款选了下游深度方案（独立 App），它的资源要由电脑推进手机，导出的自签包里装不下。
en: This game uses a dedicated port (a separate app). Its resources are copied to the phone from your computer, so they can't go into an exported self-sign package.

source: 只删资源包：手机上已装的不受影响，以后更新 S2Arm 也照样带上这款；要装到别的手机或重新推资源时再出一次包
en: Removes only the resource pack: games already on your phone keep working and still come along when you update S2Arm; make the package again only to install on another phone or copy the resources again.

source: 准备更新 iPhone 上的 S2Arm
en: Preparing the S2Arm update for iPhone

source: App 已装好、游戏照常玩。想要主屏小组件：用 Apple ID 签名（不是自己的开发者证书）再装一次；免费 Apple ID 包名额度满了就等几天再装。
en: The app is installed and games play as usual. For the Home Screen widget, install again with Apple ID signing (not your own developer certificate); if a free Apple ID has used up its app ID quota, wait a few days and install again.

source: 这次没装主屏小组件
en: Home Screen widget not installed this time

source: S2Arm 已照常装好，只是这次没带主屏小组件，原因见上。
en: S2Arm is installed as usual; only the Home Screen widget was left out this time. The reason is shown above.

source: 这个免费 Apple ID 7 天内注册的包名已满 10 个，小组件要多注册一个（App 照常装上，额度恢复后再装一次就带上）
en: This free Apple ID has registered 10 app IDs in the last 7 days; the widget needs one more (the app is installed as usual; install again after the quota recovers to get the widget)

source: 这次没装小组件：{0}
en: Home Screen widget not installed this time: {0}

source: 用你自己的开发者证书签名只有主程序一份描述文件，签不了小组件
en: Signing with your own developer certificate has a provisioning profile for the main app only, so the widget can't be signed

source: 没写构建号：文件名改成「<16 位构建号>.txt」或首行加 BID=<构建号> 才能编进 iPhone 包。
en: No build ID: rename the file to “<16-digit build ID>.txt” or add BID=<build ID> as the first line so it can go into the iPhone package.

source: 游戏卡住了，S2Arm 把这局安全停下了。
en: The game got stuck, so S2Arm stopped this session safely.

source: 点「再启动一次」一般能接着玩，存档停在游戏上次保存的地方。
en: Click “Start again” and you can usually keep playing; your save is as of the last time the game saved.

source: 游戏照常能玩、能装；只是这款的程序件里混进了不该有的大文件，多占电脑空间、装机多推一些。请导出诊断反馈给我们。
en: The game still installs and plays normally; this game's program files just picked up a large file that does not belong there, which takes extra disk space and makes installs push more data. Please export a diagnostic report and send it to us.

source: 有几张开发者证书，这台设备还没选用哪一张：在启动器里给这台选一张证书再装。
en: Several developer certificates are saved and none is chosen for this device yet. Choose one for it in the launcher, then install again.

source: 在出包页「我的开发者证书」里给这台设备选一张证书，再点「重试」。
en: On the export page, under “My developer certificate”, choose a certificate for this device, then click “Retry”.

source: 没有这张证书。
en: That certificate isn't saved on this computer.

source: 这台设备还没选证书
en: Choose a certificate for this device

source: 存着几张开发者证书，不知道这台用哪一张。
en: Several developer certificates are saved, and none is chosen for this device.

source: Switch 2 游戏在 Apple TV 上要「扩展虚拟寻址」权限，只有付费 Apple 开发者账号签得了：在 Xcode「设置 → 账户」登录付费开发者账号或选付费团队，再装到 Apple TV（Switch 1 游戏用免费 Apple ID 就能装）。
en: Switch 2 games need the Extended Virtual Addressing capability on Apple TV, which only a paid Apple Developer account can sign: sign in to a paid developer account (or pick a paid team) in Xcode's Settings → Accounts, then install on Apple TV again (Switch 1 games install with a free Apple ID).

source: 这款是 Switch 2 游戏，要「扩展虚拟寻址」权限才能在 Apple TV 上占到够用的地址，这项权限只有付费的 Apple 开发者账号签得了。在 Xcode 的「设置 → 账户」里登录付费开发者账号（或在团队里选付费团队）再装；Switch 1 游戏用免费 Apple ID 就能装。
en: This is a Switch 2 game. It needs the Extended Virtual Addressing capability to reserve enough address space on Apple TV, and only a paid Apple Developer account can sign it. Sign in to a paid developer account (or pick a paid team) in Xcode's Settings → Accounts and install again; Switch 1 games install with a free Apple ID.

source: 核对这款的 Apple TV 包
en: Checking this game's Apple TV build

source: 导出完成
en: Export finished

source: 组装 Apple TV 版 S2Arm（未签名）
en: Assembling the Apple TV version of S2Arm (unsigned)

source: 这款的 Apple TV 资源包清单没写资源包号：请重新出 Apple TV 包后再导出。
en: This game's Apple TV resource manifest has no pack ID. Build the Apple TV version again, then export.

source: 把游戏资源打进安装包（.ipa）
en: Putting the game resources into the installer (.ipa)

source: 这款的 Apple TV 资源包不完整（缺 {0} 或大小不对）：请重新出 Apple TV 包后再导出。
en: This game's Apple TV resource pack is incomplete ({0} is missing or the wrong size). Build the Apple TV version again, then export.

source: {0} 还没有 iPhone 程序件：先「打 iPhone 包」
en: {0} has no iPhone program files yet. Use "Pack for iPhone" first.

source: Xcode 看不到这台 iPhone
en: Xcode can't see this iPhone

source: 这台 iPhone 没连到这台 Mac，账号上也还没登记过它，申请不到能装到它上面的开发描述文件。
en: This iPhone isn't connected to this Mac and hasn't been registered to your account yet, so no development profile can be created for it.

source: 手机上还没装 S2Arm：先点「安装 S2Arm」，装好后再把这款推到 iPhone。
en: S2Arm is not installed on this phone yet. Click "Install S2Arm" first, then push this game to iPhone.

source: 手机上的 S2Arm 不是这一版：先点「更新 S2Arm」，再把这款推到 iPhone。
en: S2Arm on this phone is not this version. Click "Update S2Arm" first, then push this game to iPhone.

source: {0} 的程序清单在手机上就不了位（{0}）：再试一次；还不行请更新电脑上的 S2Arm。
en: {0}'s program list couldn't be put in place on the phone ({0}). Try again; if it still fails, update S2Arm on your computer.

source: 把这款的程序推进 iPhone
en: Pushing this game's program to iPhone

source: 把这款的资源推进 iPhone（只推变了的文件；第一次大游戏要几分钟）
en: Pushing this game's resources to iPhone (only changed files; a large game takes a few minutes the first time)

source: 组 S2Arm（不带游戏）
en: Building S2Arm (without games)

source: 签名并装到 iPhone
en: Signing and installing on iPhone

source: 读不到 Impactor 里登录的 Apple ID：在 Impactor 里登录后再推到 iPhone。
en: Can't read the Apple ID signed in to Impactor. Sign in to Impactor, then push to iPhone again.

source: 先在首位「S2Arm」卡把 App 装到这台设备，装好后点这台的「重试」。
en: First install the app on this device from the "S2Arm" card at the top, then click "Retry" for it.

source: 先在首位「S2Arm」卡把这台上的 App 更新到这一版，再点这台的「重试」。
en: First update the app on this device to this version from the "S2Arm" card at the top, then click "Retry" for it.

source: 手机上还没装 S2Arm
en: S2Arm is not installed on the phone

source: 「推到 iPhone」只推游戏，不装 App；这台手机上还没有 S2Arm。
en: "Push to iPhone" only sends the game and does not install the App; this phone does not have S2Arm yet.

source: 手机上的 S2Arm 要先更新
en: S2Arm on the phone needs updating first

source: 手机上的 S2Arm 是别的版本，这一版的游戏程序放上去打不开。
en: S2Arm on the phone is a different version, so game programs prepared by this version would not open there.

source: 按估算，iPhone 剩余空间可能不够：这次要传约 {0} GB，连同解开时临时多占的约要 {1} GB，手机报的空闲约 {2} GB，还差约 {3} GB。「设置 → 通用 → iPhone 储存空间」里的「可用」还包括系统随时能清掉的空间，实际多半放得下；点「仍然继续」照传，真写满了会停下并说明还差多少。
en: By estimate, iPhone storage may be low: this transfer is about {0} GB, about {1} GB including the temporary space used while unpacking, and the iPhone reports about {2} GB free, about {3} GB short. The Available figure in Settings → General → iPhone Storage also counts space iOS can clear at any time, so it usually fits; tap Continue Anyway to send it, and it stops and says how much is missing only if storage really fills up.

source: 按估算，iPhone 剩余空间可能不够：这次要传约 {0} GB，连同解开时临时多占的约要 {1} GB，手机可用约 {2} GB（含系统随时能清掉的空间），还差约 {3} GB。可以先在「设置 → 通用 → iPhone 储存空间」腾出一些，或者点「仍然继续」照传，真写满了会停下并说明还差多少。
en: By estimate, iPhone storage may be low: this transfer is about {0} GB, about {1} GB including the temporary space used while unpacking, and the iPhone has about {2} GB available (including space iOS can clear at any time), about {3} GB short. You can free some up first in Settings → General → iPhone Storage, or tap Continue Anyway to send it; it stops and says how much is missing only if storage really fills up.

source: iPhone 空间写满了，传到一半停下：这次要传约 {0} GB。在「设置 → 通用 → iPhone 储存空间」腾出空间后再装一次（已传完的文件不用重传）。
en: iPhone storage is full, so the transfer stopped partway: this transfer is about {0} GB. Free up space in Settings → General → iPhone Storage, then install again (files already sent are not sent again).

source: 手机空间写满了
en: iPhone storage is full

source: 这份游戏文件里有数据和原版对不上（多半是改版 / 整合版，或个别块损坏），已跳过完整性校验照常导入。
en: Some data in this game file does not match the original (usually a modded or merged build, or a damaged block). The integrity check was skipped and the game was imported anyway.

source: 能玩就照常用；出包或游戏里出现花屏、闪退时，换一份原版完整的文件（本体与更新 / DLC 分开的那种）再试。
en: If it plays, keep using it. If you see graphics glitches or crashes when building or playing, try again with a complete original file (base game and updates / DLC as separate files).

source: 导入时这款数据校验不过（多半是改版 / 整合版或个别块损坏），这次失败可能与此有关；换一份原版完整的文件再试。
en: This game's data failed the integrity check when it was imported (usually a modded or merged build, or a damaged block), which may be related to this failure. Try again with a complete original file.

source: 「{0}」（{1}）里是另一个游戏库，有 {2} 款游戏，不是 S2Arm 上次记下的那个。点「仍然继续」就改用它；不是你要的，就到设置里重新选游戏库。
en: “{0}” ({1}) holds a different game library with {2} games, not the one S2Arm remembered. Click Continue anyway to use it; if it isn’t the one you want, choose your game library again in Settings.

source: 点「仍然继续」改用这个游戏库；不是你要的，就到设置里重新选游戏库。
en: Click Continue anyway to use this game library; if it isn’t the one you want, choose your game library again in Settings.

source: S2Arm 读取工具与引擎版本不符，这次照常使用；解包出错时请重新安装完整的 S2Arm。
en: The S2Arm reader tool doesn't match the engine version. It will be used anyway this time; if unpacking fails, reinstall the complete S2Arm.

source: 之前出包时这款的资源包核对没对上（包里有文件和原件不一致），这次失败可能与此有关；重新出包一次再试。
en: When this game was last packaged, the resource pack check found a mismatch (some files in the pack differ from the source). This failure may be related; package it again and retry.

source: 这份 S2Arm 没装完整：程序的两部分来自不同版本（多半是应用内更新中途失败、回滚没退干净）。这次照常出包；出包失败或游戏起不来时，请从发布页下载最新的安装包，覆盖安装一次（游戏库、存档、密钥都在别处，不受影响）。
en: This S2Arm isn't fully installed: two parts of the program are from different versions (usually an in-app update failed midway and didn't roll back cleanly). Packaging continues anyway; if packaging fails or the game won't start, download the latest installer from the release page and install over it (your library, saves and keys are stored elsewhere and are not affected).

source: 这款存档在 iCloud 云存档里有一份（{0}），覆盖装不会碰它：这次不另备份，照装
en: This game's saves have a copy in your iCloud cloud saves ({0}), which overwriting the app won't touch: installing without a separate backup this time

source: 这台 Mac 空间不够，存档备份放不下（只剩 {0} MB）：腾出 {1} GB 再试，或者确认后继续
en: This Mac is out of space and the save backup doesn't fit (only {0} MB left): free up {1} GB and try again, or confirm to continue

source: 按顺序把所选游戏推到 iPhone
en: Pushing the selected games to your iPhone one by one

source: 准备这款的程序（按需更新）
en: Preparing this game’s program (updating it if needed)

source: 打包 .s2arm
en: Packing the .s2arm file

source: 写进「S2Arm 游戏包」文件夹
en: Writing it to the “S2Arm Game Packs” folder

source: 这款需要更多内存：已经记下要多少，再点一次开始就能进。
en: This game needs more memory: how much has been noted, so start it again and it will run.

source: 再点一次「开始」就能进：这一局已记下这款要的内存，下次起局按它给。
en: Click Start again to play: this session noted how much memory the game needs, and the next start uses it.

source: 把存档还原到 iPhone
en: Restoring saves to the iPhone

source: 写回存档文件
en: Writing the save files back

source: 找不到这份存档备份：请在列表里重新选一份。
en: This save backup was not found: pick another one in the list.

source: 先在 {0} 上退出 S2Arm，再还原存档。
en: Close S2Arm on the {0} first, then restore the saves.

source: 在 {0} 上从后台划掉 S2Arm（或回到主屏后等几秒），再点一次还原。
en: Close S2Arm on the {0} (swipe it away from the app switcher), then restore again.

source: 这份文件要 master_key_{0}，你的 prod.keys 只到 master_key_{1}：不够新。
en: This file needs master_key_{0}, but your prod.keys only goes up to master_key_{1}: it is not new enough.

source: 这份文件要 master_key_{0}，你的 prod.keys 有到 master_key_{1}：代数够，多半是这一行的值不对。
en: This file needs master_key_{0}, and your prod.keys goes up to master_key_{1}: the generation is there, so that key's value is most likely wrong.

source: 这份文件的内容被改过或损坏了：同一份文件里用同一代密钥的其它内容能正常解开，密钥是对的。请换一份原版完整的文件（XCI / NSP）再导入。
en: This file's content has been modified or is damaged: other content in the same file uses the same key generation and decrypts fine, so your keys are correct. Import an original, complete file (XCI / NSP) instead.

source: 程序文件 {0} 的 {1} 段解不开：这个程序文件坏了或被改过，请重新导出（最好导成 NSP / XCI）。
en: The {1} segment of program file {0} can't be decompressed: this program file is damaged or has been modified. Export it again (preferably as an NSP / XCI).

source: 这是 Apple 对免费 Apple ID 的限制：7 天内最多注册 10 个包名，这个账号已经用满；在手机上删 App 不会退还额度。办法：等几天，最早那批包名注册满 7 天就会恢复；或换一个 Apple ID 登录后再装（Mac 在 S2Arm 里登录，Windows 在 Impactor 里登录）；或改用付费 Apple 开发者账号（没有这个限制）。
en: This is Apple's limit for free Apple IDs: at most 10 App IDs can be registered in 7 days, and this account has used them all. Removing apps from the iPhone does not give the quota back. Options: wait a few days, as the quota comes back once the earliest App IDs are 7 days old; sign in with a different Apple ID and install again (in S2Arm on Mac, in Impactor on Windows); or use a paid Apple Developer account, which has no such limit.

source: 先装 Impactor：在 S2Arm 里点「打开官方页面」打开官方发布页（https://github.com/claration/impactor/releases/tag/v2.7.3），下载免安装版放到桌面，再点「重新检查」。
en: Install Impactor first: click Open the official page in S2Arm to open the official release page (https://github.com/claration/impactor/releases/tag/v2.7.3), save the portable build to the desktop, then click Recheck.

source: 换成实测过的 Impactor 2.7.3（官方发布页 https://github.com/claration/impactor/releases/tag/v2.7.3）；别的版本可能丢掉「提高内存上限」权限，大游戏会闪退。
en: Switch to the tested Impactor 2.7.3 (official release page https://github.com/claration/impactor/releases/tag/v2.7.3); other versions may drop the increased-memory-limit entitlement and large games may crash.

source: 这台电脑上没有这个 Apple ID 能用的开发证书，要新建一张。账号证书满了的话，苹果会撤掉列表里的第一张「{0}」（在 {1} 上创建，{2} 生效）。在 AltStore / SideStore 上创建的那张就是它们在用的证书，撤掉后 AltStore / SideStore 和它们装的 App 会打不开。
en: This computer has no usable development certificate for this Apple ID, so it needs to create one. If your account's certificates are full, Apple will revoke the first one in the list, “{0}” (created on {1}, valid from {2}). If it was created on AltStore / SideStore, it is the certificate they are using: once it is revoked, AltStore / SideStore and the apps they installed will stop opening.

source: 这台电脑上没有这个 Apple ID 能用的开发证书，要新建一张。账号证书满了的话，苹果会撤掉列表里的第一张「{0}」（{1} 生效）。在 AltStore / SideStore 上创建的那张就是它们在用的证书，撤掉后 AltStore / SideStore 和它们装的 App 会打不开。
en: This computer has no usable development certificate for this Apple ID, so it needs to create one. If your account's certificates are full, Apple will revoke the first one in the list, “{0}” (valid from {1}). If it was created on AltStore / SideStore, it is the certificate they are using: once it is revoked, AltStore / SideStore and the apps they installed will stop opening.

source: 点「仍然继续」会新建证书照签。不想动现有证书的话，点「改用已有证书」，把在 AltStore / SideStore 导出的 .p12 导进来，就不用新建。
en: Click Continue anyway to create a new certificate and sign. To keep your current certificates, click Use an existing certificate and import the .p12 you exported from AltStore / SideStore, so nothing new is created.

source: 这是分发（发布）证书的描述文件，缺下面的权限，S2Arm 0.6 起用它签出来的 App 每款游戏都打不开：
en: This is a distribution (release) certificate profile and it lacks the entitlements below, so since S2Arm 0.6 every game in an app signed with it fails to open:

source: 调试权限（get-task-allow）——没有它任何游戏都打不开
en: Debugging (get-task-allow) — without it, no game can open

source: 提高内存上限（com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit）——没有它大游戏可能内存不够、起不来
en: Increased Memory Limit (com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit) — without it, large games may run out of memory and fail to start

source: 扩展寻址（com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing）——没有它大游戏可能地址不够、起不来
en: Extended Virtual Addressing (com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing) — without it, large games may run out of address space and fail to start

source: 可以改用 Apple ID 登录签名，或复制下面这段话发给证书发放人，换成开发证书和开发描述文件后再导入。
en: Sign with your Apple ID instead, or copy the message below and send it to whoever issued the certificate, then import a development certificate and development profile.

source: 描述文件缺下面的权限，小游戏照常，大游戏可能起不来：
en: The profile lacks the entitlements below. Small games work as usual; large games may fail to start:

source: 可以复制下面这段话发给证书发放人，补开后重新下载描述文件再导入。
en: Copy the message below and send it to whoever issued the certificate; once they enable these, download the profile again and import it.

source: 没连着 iPhone：复制后把「<你的设备 UDID>」换成你手机的 UDID。
en: No iPhone connected: after copying, replace “<your device UDID>” with your iPhone’s UDID.

source: 请提供 Apple Development 开发证书（.p12，附密码）和对应的 iOS App Development 开发描述文件。描述文件要求：用显式 App ID（不要通配 *），包含我的设备 UDID：{0}，并开启以下权限：调试权限（get-task-allow）、提高内存上限（com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit）、扩展寻址（com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing）。
en: Please provide an Apple Development certificate (.p12, with its password) and a matching iOS App Development provisioning profile. Profile requirements: use an explicit App ID (not a wildcard *), include my device UDID: {0}, and enable these entitlements: Debugging (get-task-allow), Increased Memory Limit (com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit), Extended Virtual Addressing (com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing).

source: 请提供 Apple Development 开发证书（.p12，附密码）和对应的 iOS App Development 开发描述文件。描述文件要求：用显式 App ID（不要通配 *），包含我的设备 UDID：<你的设备 UDID>，并开启以下权限：调试权限（get-task-allow）、提高内存上限（com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit）、扩展寻址（com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing）。
en: Please provide an Apple Development certificate (.p12, with its password) and a matching iOS App Development provisioning profile. Profile requirements: use an explicit App ID (not a wildcard *), include my device UDID: <your device UDID>, and enable these entitlements: Debugging (get-task-allow), Increased Memory Limit (com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit), Extended Virtual Addressing (com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing).

source: 只选了 .p12 证书时，S2Arm 用你登录的 Apple ID 自己申请描述文件：先用 Apple ID 登录再导入；不用 Apple ID 的话，请再选上这张证书配套的描述文件（.mobileprovision）。
en: With only a .p12 certificate, S2Arm requests the provisioning profile itself using the Apple ID you're signed in with: sign in with your Apple ID first, then import. If you don't use an Apple ID, also choose the provisioning profile (.mobileprovision) that goes with this certificate.

source: 这个版本的签名工具还不能沿用导入的证书：更新 S2Arm 后再导入，或者再选上这张证书配套的描述文件（.mobileprovision）。
en: This version of the signing tool can't reuse an imported certificate yet: update S2Arm and import again, or also choose the provisioning profile (.mobileprovision) that goes with this certificate.

source: 这张证书不在当前登录的 Apple ID（团队 {0}）的证书列表里：它可能属于别的 Apple ID，或已被撤销。改用这张证书所属的 Apple ID 登录后再导入，或者再选上这张证书配套的描述文件（.mobileprovision）。
en: This certificate isn't in the certificate list of the Apple ID you're signed in with (team {0}): it may belong to another Apple ID, or it has been revoked. Sign in with the Apple ID it belongs to and import again, or also choose the provisioning profile (.mobileprovision) that goes with this certificate.

source: 没能列出这个 Apple ID 的证书（网络不通或登录已过期），这次什么都没改：检查网络、必要时重新登录 Apple ID，再导入一次。
en: Couldn't list this Apple ID's certificates (no network, or the sign-in has expired), so nothing was changed: check the network, sign in to your Apple ID again if needed, and import once more.

source: 已改用这张证书：之后用 Apple ID 签名时，S2Arm 用它签名、用你的 Apple ID 自己申请描述文件，不新建证书，也不会撤销 SideStore / AltStore 正在用的证书。回到装机页再装一次即可。
en: Now using this certificate: when signing with your Apple ID, S2Arm signs with it and requests provisioning profiles with your Apple ID itself. No new certificate is created, and the one SideStore / AltStore is using won't be revoked. Go back to the install page and install again.

source: 读取证书
en: Reading the certificate

source: 核对 Apple ID 里的证书
en: Checking the certificates in your Apple ID

source: 从帖子里完整复制那一整串诊断码（以 S2A-DIAG1- 开头）再粘一次；还不行就在帖子里回复，请维护者重发一条。
en: Copy the whole diagnostic code from the post again (it starts with S2A-DIAG1-) and paste it once more. If it still fails, reply in the post and ask the maintainer to send a new one.

source: 证书里的私钥读不出来，没能交给 {0} 上的 S2Arm：在设置里重新导入一次证书。
en: Couldn't read the private key in your certificate, so it wasn't handed to S2Arm on your {0}. Import the certificate again in Settings.

source: 把证书交给 {0} 上的 S2Arm
en: Handing the certificate to S2Arm on your {0}

source: 现在没在用你自己的开发者证书签名，没有要交给 {0} 的证书：先在设置里导入并选用你的证书。
en: You're not signing with your own developer certificate, so there's no certificate to hand to your {0}. Import and select your certificate in Settings first.

source: 苹果的证书列表里找不到这台电脑签名用的那张证书，没能交给 {0} 上的 S2Arm：先在电脑上「安装 S2Arm」一次。
en: Apple's certificate list doesn't have the certificate this computer signs with, so it wasn't handed to S2Arm on your {0}. Run “Install S2Arm” on this computer once first.

source: 没能把证书写进 {0} 上的 S2Arm：确认它连着、已解锁，再试一次。
en: Couldn't write the certificate into S2Arm on your {0}. Make sure it is connected and unlocked, then try again.

source: 这款游戏正在升级 S 级优化，升级完成后就能开始。
en: This game is upgrading its S-Grade optimization. You can start it once the upgrade finishes.

source: 这款游戏正在运行或正在升级，等它结束后再点「S 级优化」。
en: This game is running or already upgrading. Click “S-Grade optimization” again after it finishes.

source: 补上 S 级优化（满屏 / 帧率 / 金手指）
en: Adding S-Grade optimization (full screen / frame rate / cheats)

source: 补上片上读取用的着色器（首次要几分钟）
en: Adding on-chip read shaders (first time takes a few minutes)

source: 补上 iPhone 版的 S 级优化
en: Adding S-Grade optimization to the iPhone version

source: 等这款的 S 级优化升级做完（游戏上有进度），再点开始游戏；别的游戏照常能玩。
en: Wait for this game's S-Grade optimization upgrade to finish (progress shows on the game), then click Start. Other games can be played as usual.

source: 登录 Apple ID
en: Sign in with Apple ID

source: 等你填验证码
en: Waiting for your verification code

en: Apple ID sign-in failed: {0}

en: Not signed in with an Apple ID yet: sign in with your Apple ID in S2Arm once (email, password and the verification code on your phone), then install on iPhone.

source: 在「Windows 安全中心 → 保护历史记录」看是谁拦的。杀毒软件拦的：把 S2Arm 安装文件夹加进信任再重试；「智能应用控制」拦的：它不能单独放行，只能在「应用和浏览器控制 → 智能应用控制」里关掉（关掉后要重装 Windows 才能再打开）；公司电脑请让管理员放行。
en: Check Windows Security → Protection history to see what blocked it. If it was antivirus, add the S2Arm install folder to its trusted list and try again. If it was Smart App Control, it can't allow a single app — it can only be turned off under App & browser control → Smart App Control (turning it off needs a Windows reinstall to turn it back on). On a work PC, ask your administrator to allow it.

en: one of S2Arm's own tools

en: The S2Arm signed this time is missing the "Increased Memory Limit" entitlement: it installs and runs, but large games may run out of memory and stop at launch.

en: This Mac can't reach the {0}'s developer connection (most common when it is connected over Wi-Fi; it isn't about being locked): plug it straight into this Mac with a cable (not through a dock or hub), unlock it to the Home Screen, and try again. If it still fails, restart it, plug it back in and tap "Trust" again on the device.

en: Couldn’t go back to the previous save, and some saves couldn’t be switched back. Please export a diagnostic report.

en: Only available while the device type is Built-in speakers.

en: Only available while the device type is Headphones.

en: Finding the iPhone

en: Can't tell the bundle ID of S2Arm on the iPhone (it was never installed from this computer and the current signing account can't be read). Click "Install S2Arm" once on this computer, then delete again.

source: 先在 {0} 上退出 S2Arm，再删这款。
en: Quit S2Arm on the {0} first, then delete this game.

source: 起局前已知：{0}
en: Known before launch: {0}

en: This game's .img in the “S2Arm Self-Sign Export” folder: games already imported on your phone are not affected; export a self-sign package again when you want to install it on a phone.

source: iPhone 包已出好。用数据线连上 iPhone，在打包任务页点「推到 iPhone」就能装上（也可以按装机步骤改用 AltStore）。
en: iPhone package ready. Connect your iPhone with a cable and click “Push to iPhone” on the Packing page (or use AltStore — see the install steps).

source: 回到 S2Arm，在打包任务页点「推到 iPhone」：自动签名、安装，并把资源包拷进去、逐个文件核对。
en: Back in S2Arm, click “Push to iPhone” on the Packing page: it signs, installs, and copies the resource pack, checking every file.

source: 已推到 iPhone
en: Pushed to iPhone

source: 推到 iPhone
en: Push to iPhone

source: 打开 Xcode →「设置」→「账户」，点「+」登录你的 Apple ID（免费的就可以），再点一次「推到 iPhone」；不想登录 Xcode 也可以改用 AltStore 安装。
en: Open Xcode → Settings → Accounts, sign in with your Apple ID (a free account works), then retry installation. AltStore is also an installation option.

source: 解锁这台设备（保持亮屏、停在主屏幕），再点这台的「重试」；装的过程中别锁屏。
en: Unlock this device (screen on, on the Home Screen), then click "Retry" for it. Don't lock it while installing.

source: iPhone 包已出好。用数据线连上 iPhone，在编译任务页点「推到 iPhone」就能装上（也可以按装机步骤改用 AltStore）。
en: iPhone package ready. Connect your iPhone with a cable and click “Push to iPhone” on the Compiling page (or use AltStore — see the install steps).

source: 回到 S2Arm，在编译任务页点「推到 iPhone」：自动签名、安装，并把资源包拷进去、逐个文件核对。
en: Back in S2Arm, click “Push to iPhone” on the Compiling page: it signs, installs, and copies the resource pack, checking every file.

source: iPhone 包已出好。可以用数据线连上 iPhone，在打包任务页点「推到 iPhone」（这条路还在真机验证，装不上请按装机步骤改用 AltStore）。
en: iPhone package ready. You can connect your iPhone with a cable and click “Push to iPhone” on the Packing page (this path is still being verified on real devices; if it fails, use AltStore — see the install steps).

source: 没找到可用的开发签名团队：请在 Xcode「设置 → 账户」确认 Apple ID、团队和开发证书，再点一次「推到 iPhone」。
en: No usable development signing team: check the Apple ID, team and development certificate in Xcode Settings → Accounts, then click Push to iPhone again.

source: 在装机页点「解决办法」打开引导项目，在 Xcode 里选 Personal Team，连上手机点运行一次，再点一次「推到 iPhone」。也可以先到 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts 看团队列表有没有显示。
en: On the install page, click How to fix to open the helper project, choose Personal Team in Xcode, connect your phone and run it once, then install again. You can also check whether the team list appears under Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts.

source: 打开 Xcode，点菜单 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts，选中账号后点 Manage Certificates，点 + 选 Apple Development，再点一次「推到 iPhone」。
en: Open Xcode, choose Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts, select your account, click Manage Certificates, click + and choose Apple Development, then install again.

source: 确认后再点一次：点名的游戏会暂时不能玩（存档和资源包留在手机上），到装它们的那台电脑上再「推到 iPhone」一次就回来；不想这样就先别装。
en: Click again to confirm: the games named will stop working for now (their saves and resources stay on the phone). Install them on iPhone again from the computer they came from to bring them back. If you don't want that, don't install now.

source: 在这台 Mac 屏幕上的钥匙串弹窗里点「始终允许」（需要的话输入 Mac 登录密码），再点一次「推到 iPhone」。
en: In the keychain prompt on this Mac's screen, click "Always Allow" (enter your Mac login password if asked), then install on iPhone again.

source: Apple ID 登录已过期，请重新登录后再装：在导出页点「打开 Impactor」→「设置」，选中你的 Apple ID 点「移除账号」，再点「添加账号」用同一个 Apple ID 重新登录（邮箱、密码、手机上的验证码，输入前切到英文输入法），然后回来点这台的「重试」。密码只在 Impactor 里输，S2Arm 不经手。
en: Your Apple ID sign-in has expired. Sign in again, then install: on the export page click Open Impactor → Settings, select your Apple ID and click Remove Account, then Add Account and sign in with the same Apple ID (email, password and the code on your devices; switch the keyboard to English first). Come back and click "Retry" for this device. You enter the password only in Impactor; S2Arm never sees it.

source: 手机上已经有一个用别的签名装的 S2Arm（包名相同、签名不同），系统不让覆盖。二选一：继续用你原来的签名工具更新它；或者在 iPhone 上长按 S2Arm 删掉它（里面的存档会一起删，先在 S2Arm 里导出存档），再点「推到 iPhone」。
en: Your iPhone already has an S2Arm installed with a different signature (same app ID, different signer), and iOS won't replace it. Either keep updating it with your own signing tool, or long-press S2Arm on the iPhone and delete it (its saves go with it, so export them in S2Arm first), then click Push to iPhone again.

source: 这台电脑连不上 Impactor 签名要用的登录辅助服务器（mac-ani.jkcoxson.com，Impactor 内置、改不了），已自动重试过一次。检查这台电脑的网络：浏览器能打开这个地址就再点一次「推到 iPhone」；打不开就换个 DNS（如 223.5.5.5 或 1.1.1.1）或开 / 关代理后再装。手机、已装的 App 和存档都不受影响。
en: This computer cannot reach the sign-in helper server Impactor needs for signing (mac-ani.jkcoxson.com, built into Impactor and not configurable); S2Arm already retried once. Check this computer's network: if a browser can open that address, click Push to iPhone again; if not, switch DNS (for example 223.5.5.5 or 1.1.1.1) or turn a proxy on or off, then install again. The iPhone, installed apps and saves are not affected.

source: 它们是在别的电脑上装的，到那台电脑上再「推到 iPhone」一次就回来：{0}
en: Installed from another computer; they come back once you "Push to iPhone" again from that computer: {0}

source: 确认后再点一次：点名的游戏会暂时打不开（存档和资源包留在手机上）。别的电脑装的，到那台电脑上再「推到 iPhone」一次就回来；已从游戏库删除的，重新加回、「打 iPhone 包」再装就回来。不想这样就先别装。
en: Confirm and try again: the games named won't open for now (their saves and resources stay on the phone). Ones installed from another computer come back once you "Push to iPhone" again from that computer; ones deleted from the library come back once you add them again, "Build for iPhone" and install. If you don't want that, don't install yet.

source: 手机上的游戏都要按新版重新出包，这次没法只更新 S2Arm（更新后一款都打不开）。可以先给它们各「打 iPhone 包」，再点「推到 iPhone」，游戏和 S2Arm 会一起换成新版；存档和资源都留在手机上。「只更新 S2Arm、暂不带游戏」下一版开放。
en: All games on the phone need to be built again for the new version, so S2Arm can't be updated on its own this time (none would open afterwards). Build the iPhone package for each, then click "Push to iPhone"; the games and S2Arm will be updated together, and saves and resources stay on the phone. "Update only S2Arm without games" comes in the next version.

en: S2Arm.ipa in the library folder wasn't updated this time ({0}). This game's iPhone version is ready and will be assembled as usual when you install to iPhone.

source: 这款选的下游方案是独立 App，资源要由电脑推进去：连上手机后点「推到 iPhone」；想导出自签包就在确认页改选「仍用原版方案」。
en: The port chosen for this game is a separate app whose resources are copied over from your computer: connect your phone and click Push to iPhone. To export a self-sign package instead, choose Keep the standard route on the confirmation page.

en: No Apple ID is signed in to Impactor: on the export page click Open Impactor → Settings → Add Account and sign in with your Apple ID (email, password and the code on your devices; switch the keyboard to English first). If several accounts are saved, select the one you want (or remove it and add it again). Then come back and click "Retry" for this device. You enter the password only in Impactor; S2Arm never sees it.

en: This computer cannot reach Apple's servers (Impactor needs them to sign in and to sign). This is not a problem with your Apple ID or password. Check this computer's network: if a browser can open appleid.apple.com, click Push to iPhone again; if it cannot, switch DNS (for example 1.1.1.1) or turn your proxy on or off, then install again. Your phone, installed apps and saves were not touched.

source: 用数据线把这台 {0} 连到这台 Mac，解锁后在设备上点「信任」；打开开发者模式（设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式，开了要重启）；等 Xcode 菜单「窗口 → 设备与模拟器」里出现这台，再点一次「推到 iPhone」。

source: 先试这两步：①在 iPhone 上打开一次 S2Arm，等游戏库界面出来；②回电脑对这款游戏再点一次「推到 iPhone」，会接着已传的部分继续，不用从头来。还是写不进，就要删掉 iPhone 上的 S2Arm App 再重装：先在游戏菜单「存档管理」里导出存档，存到 S2Arm 文件夹以外（比如 iCloud 云盘）；再在 iPhone 桌面长按 S2Arm，删除 App；然后在电脑上的 S2Arm 里对这款游戏再点一次「推到 iPhone」；装好后在「存档管理」里导回存档。电脑上的游戏和 S2Arm 都不用删。
en: Try these two steps first: 1) Open S2Arm on the iPhone once and wait for the game library to appear; 2) Back on your computer, click “Push to iPhone” for this game again. It picks up from what was already copied, so it won’t start over. If it still can’t write, delete the S2Arm app on your iPhone and install it again: export your saves from the game menu (Manage saves) to a place outside the S2Arm folder, such as iCloud Drive; on the iPhone Home Screen, touch and hold S2Arm and delete the app; in S2Arm on your computer, click Push to iPhone for this game again; once it’s installed, import your saves again in Manage saves. You don’t need to delete the games or S2Arm on your computer.

source:
按你装 S2Arm 的方式补上：
· 电脑上的 S2Arm（免费或付费 Apple ID）：点游戏库第一格「S2Arm」里的「续签 S2Arm」重装一次；重装后还看到这条提示，就用下面的 GetMoreRam 补上，再点一次「续签 S2Arm」。
· 自己的开发者证书（.p12 + 描述文件）：在苹果开发者网站给 S2Arm 的 App ID（苹果给每个 App 登记的身份）打开「Increased Memory Limit」，重新生成描述文件，用新描述文件重签再装。
· AltStore：用 AltStore Classic 2.2 或更新版重装（不是刷新）。
· SideStore 0.7.0：签名会丢这项权限，用下面的 GetMoreRam 补上后，在 SideStore 里重装。
· Sideloadly：暂不支持，它没说免费账号会保留这项权限，自定义权限要付费开发者账号。
· GetMoreRam：用装 S2Arm 的同一个 Apple ID 把它自签装到手机（占免费账号一个 App 名额，用完可删），登录后打开 App IDs、点刷新、选 S2Arm、点「Add Increased Memory Limit」，再用原来的方式重装 S2Arm。
en:
Fix it the way you installed S2Arm:
· S2Arm on your computer (free or paid Apple ID): click “Renew S2Arm” on the S2Arm card first in the library to reinstall. If you still see this message afterwards, add the permission with GetMoreRam below, then click “Renew S2Arm” again.
· Your own developer certificate (.p12 + provisioning profile): on the Apple Developer website, turn on “Increased Memory Limit” for S2Arm’s App ID (the identity Apple registers for each app), regenerate the provisioning profile, then re-sign and install with the new profile.
· AltStore: reinstall (not refresh) with AltStore Classic 2.2 or later.
· SideStore 0.7.0: its signing drops this permission; add it with GetMoreRam below, then reinstall in SideStore.
· Sideloadly: not supported for now; it doesn’t say it keeps this permission with a free Apple ID, and custom entitlements need a paid Apple Developer account.
· GetMoreRam: sideload it with the same Apple ID you used for S2Arm (it takes one of a free account’s app slots; delete it afterwards), sign in, open App IDs, tap Refresh, choose S2Arm, tap “Add Increased Memory Limit”, then reinstall S2Arm the way you did before.

source: 苹果已经接受了验证码，但随后又要求再验证一次，再输也会一直这样，所以 S2Arm 先停下了。请改用在你自己的 iPhone 或 iPad 上登录着的那个 Apple ID 来登录（验证码会弹在那台设备上）；还不行请把诊断发给我们。
en: Apple accepted the verification code but then asked for another one, and it would keep doing that however many codes you enter, so S2Arm stopped. Sign in with the Apple ID that's signed in on your own iPhone or iPad instead (the code will appear on that device). If that still doesn't work, please send us a diagnostic.

source: 打开「Windows 安全中心 → 应用和浏览器控制 → 漏洞利用保护设置 → 系统设置」，把「强制映像随机化（强制性 ASLR）」改回「使用默认值（关）」，再打一次包。
en: Open Windows Security → App & browser control → Exploit protection settings → System settings, set "Force randomization for images (Mandatory ASLR)" back to "Use default (Off)", then package again.

source: 游戏输入键 {0}
en: Game input key {0}

source: 这是分发（发布）证书的描述文件，缺下面的权限：可以照常用它装「独立 App」（一个 App 一款游戏），通用 S2Arm 里的游戏用它签了打不开。
en: This is a distribution (release) certificate profile and it lacks the entitlements below. You can still use it to install Standalone Apps (one app per game), but games in the universal S2Arm won't open when signed with it.

source: 要用通用 S2Arm：改用 Apple ID 登录签名，或复制下面这段话发给证书发放人，换成开发证书和开发描述文件后再导入。
en: To use the universal S2Arm: sign with your Apple ID instead, or copy the message below and send it to whoever issued the certificate, then import a development certificate and development profile.

source: 调试权限（get-task-allow）——没有它，通用 S2Arm 里的游戏打不开（「独立 App」不受影响）
en: Debugging (get-task-allow) — without it, games in the universal S2Arm can't open (Standalone Apps aren't affected)

source: 免费 Apple ID 有苹果的限制：同时最多装 3 个自己签的 App（AltStore / SideStore 也算），每 7 天最多注册 10 个 App ID；独立 App 每款占一个。
en: A free Apple ID has Apple's limits: at most 3 self-signed apps installed at once (AltStore / SideStore count too), and at most 10 App IDs registered every 7 days. Each Standalone App uses one.

source: 组这款的独立 App
en: Building this game's Standalone App

source: 描述文件是显式 App ID，只能用它那一个包名 {0}：每款独立 App 和通用 S2Arm 都装成它，装一个会顶掉另一个。
en: The profile uses an explicit App ID, so only its one bundle ID {0} can be used: every Standalone App and the universal S2Arm install as it, and installing one replaces the other.

source: 现在用的证书缺「调试权限（get-task-allow）」（分发证书），通用 S2Arm 里的游戏打不开：在设置里把出法改成「独立 App」就能玩。
en: The certificate in use lacks the debugging entitlement (get-task-allow) (it's a distribution certificate), so games in the universal S2Arm can't open. Switch the install style to Standalone App in Settings to play.

source: 「{0}」的独立 App 要按新版重新出包：先给它「打 iPhone 包」，再推到 iPhone。
en: The Standalone App for "{0}" needs to be built again for the new version: run "Build for iPhone" for it, then push it to the iPhone.

source: 「{0}」的独立 App 这次没更新：{1}
en: The Standalone App for "{0}" wasn't updated this time: {1}

source: 现在用的证书是分发（发布）证书，缺「调试权限（get-task-allow）」：通用 S2Arm 里的游戏用它签了打不开。在设置里把出法改成「独立 App」（一个 App 一款游戏）就能玩；或改用 Apple ID 登录签名、换成开发证书。
en: The certificate in use is a distribution (release) certificate and lacks the debugging entitlement (get-task-allow): games in the universal S2Arm won't open when signed with it. Switch the install style to Standalone App (one app per game) in Settings to play, or sign with your Apple ID or a development certificate instead.

source: 你的描述文件是显式 App ID，只有一个包名：每款独立 App 和通用 S2Arm 都只能装成它，装一个会顶掉另一个（存档跟着那个 App 走）。想同时装多款，请让证书发放人给通配（*）的描述文件。
en: Your profile uses an explicit App ID with only one bundle ID: every Standalone App and the universal S2Arm can only install as it, and installing one replaces the other (saves stay with that app). To install several games side by side, ask whoever issued the certificate for a wildcard (*) profile.

source: 免费 Apple ID 有苹果的限制：同时最多装 3 个自己签的 App（AltStore / SideStore 也算），每 7 天最多注册 10 个 App ID；独立 App 每款占一个。装满了就在 iPhone 上删掉不玩的那个再装。
en: A free Apple ID has Apple's limits: at most 3 self-signed apps installed at once (AltStore / SideStore count too), and at most 10 App IDs registered every 7 days. Each Standalone App uses one. If you hit the limit, delete an app you no longer play from the iPhone and install again.

source: 推到 iPhone 的方式选「独立 App」，用这张证书照常能玩；要用通用 S2Arm：点「改用 Apple ID 登录」用 Apple ID 签名，或点「复制给证书发放人的话」发给对方，换成开发证书和开发描述文件后重新导入。
en: Choose “Standalone app” as the way games go to your iPhone and this certificate works as usual. To use the S2Arm app instead, click “Sign In with Apple ID Instead” to sign with your Apple ID, or click “Copy Message for Certificate Issuer” and send it to them, then import the development certificate and profile you get back.

source: 先在 {0} 上退出这款游戏，再删。
en: Quit this game on the {0} first, then remove it.

source: 没能从 {0} 上卸掉这款的独立 App：确认它连着、已解锁，再试一次。
en: Couldn't remove this game's standalone app from the {0}. Make sure it is connected and unlocked, then try again.

source: 从 iPhone 上卸掉这款的独立 App
en: Removing this game's standalone app from the iPhone

source: 这款在电脑上的游戏文件夹不在了（被删或挪走），没有装到 iPhone。
en: This game’s folder on the computer is gone (deleted or moved); nothing was installed on the iPhone.

source: 在启动器里重新添加这款游戏、打一次 iPhone 包，再装到 iPhone 或续签；手机上已装的 App 和存档不受影响。
en: Add this game again in the launcher and build the iPhone package once, then install or renew. The app already on the phone and its saves aren’t affected.

source: 写进这款的游戏文件夹
en: Writing to this game’s folder

source: 应用不完整，请重新安装 S2Arm。
en: The app is incomplete. Reinstall S2Arm.

source: 不另占空间
en: no extra space

source: 这款游戏暂时出不了包：没认出它用的图形接口（NVN / Vulkan / OpenGL）。请把诊断发给我们，我们会核对是不是没认出来。
en: This game can't be packed yet: we couldn't identify which graphics API it uses (NVN / Vulkan / OpenGL). Please send us a diagnostic so we can check whether we missed it.

source: 苹果的登录服务器拒收了这次登录请求（回了「服务暂不可用」，还没到核对账号密码那一步），不是这台电脑的网络、Apple ID 或密码的问题，换网络、换 DNS 也没用。多半是苹果又调整了对第三方签名工具的规则：把 S2Arm 更新到最新版后再登录；最新版仍这样，点「复制错误摘要」发给我们。手机、已装的 App 和存档都没动。
en: Apple's sign-in server refused this sign-in request (it answered "service unavailable" before checking your account). This is not a problem with this computer's network, your Apple ID or your password, and switching networks or DNS will not help. Apple most likely changed its rules for third-party signing tools: update S2Arm to the latest version and sign in again. If the latest version still shows this, click "Copy error summary" and send it to us. Your phone, installed apps and saves were not touched.

source: 这次没能读到开发者证书设置（这台电脑拒绝 S2Arm 读它自己的证书设置文件夹），按 Apple ID 签名。如果你启用过自己的开发者证书，这次没有用它。
en: Could not read your developer certificate settings this time (this computer denied S2Arm access to its own certificate settings folder), so this was signed with your Apple ID. If you had turned on your own developer certificate, it was not used this time.

source: 要用自己的开发者证书：检查杀毒软件或 Windows 安全中心的「受控文件夹访问」有没有拦 S2Arm（把 S2Arm 加进允许的应用），然后在设置里重新导入证书。没启用过开发者证书可以不管这条。
en: To use your own developer certificate: check whether antivirus software or Controlled folder access in Windows Security is blocking S2Arm (add S2Arm to the allowed apps), then import the certificate again in Settings. If you never turned on a developer certificate, you can ignore this.

source: 这款的着色器库这次没能重编：这台电脑没装 Metal 开发工具。在「准备这台电脑」装好后再点「更新这款」；「建议更新」会继续显示。
en: This game's shader library couldn't be rebuilt this time: the Metal developer tools aren't installed on this computer. Install them in "Prepare this computer", then click "Update this game" again; "Update suggested" stays until then.

source: 这款的着色器库这次没能重编：游戏库里重编要用的游戏文件不在了。原件还在，正在从原件整款重新出包（约几分钟到几十分钟）。
en: This game's shader library couldn't be rebuilt this time: the game files needed to rebuild it are no longer in the library. The original is still there, so the whole game is being rebuilt from it (a few minutes to tens of minutes).

source: 这款的着色器库这次没能重编：游戏库里重编要用的游戏文件和这款的原件都不在了。点「重新添加原件…」选这款的原件，找回后会自动从原件整款重新出包。
en: This game's shader library couldn't be rebuilt this time: neither the game files needed to rebuild it nor this game's original file are available. Click "Re-add original…" to pick this game's original; once it's found, the whole game is rebuilt from it automatically.

source: 选的是另一款游戏（{0}），不是这一款（{1}）：这款的记录没有改动，请选这款的原件。
en: That's a different game ({0}), not this one ({1}): nothing was changed. Pick this game's original file.

source: 这款在这台 Mac 上正在运行，Mac 版的着色器库这次没更新：退出游戏后再点一次「更新这款」。
en: This game is running on this Mac, so the Mac version's shader library was not updated this time. Quit the game and click "Update this game" again.

source: 这款要整款重新出包才能更新完（运行环境的约定变了，只换着色器库不够）：正在从原件整款重新出包（约几分钟到几十分钟）。
en: This game needs a full rebuild to finish updating (the runtime contract changed; replacing the shader library is not enough): the whole game is being rebuilt from its original (a few minutes to tens of minutes).

source: 这款要整款重新出包才能更新完（运行环境的约定变了，只换着色器库不够），但这款的原件不在了。点「重新添加原件…」选这款的原件，找回后会自动从原件整款重新出包。
en: This game needs a full rebuild to finish updating (the runtime contract changed; replacing the shader library is not enough), but its original file is no longer available. Click "Re-add original…" to pick this game's original; once it's found, the whole game is rebuilt from it automatically.

source: 按黄字里写的补上缺的那一项，再点一次「更新这款」；其余部分这次已经更新好了。
en: Finish the missing item described in yellow, then click "Update this game" again; everything else was already updated this time.

source: 这款有一项没更新完
en: Part of this update was not completed

source: 「更新这款」这次有一部分没做成，原因写在下面；「建议更新」会继续显示，按说明处理后再点一次。
en: "Update this game" could not finish everything this time; the reason is below. "Update suggested" will keep showing until you follow it and click again.

source: 更新这款
en: Update this game

source: 更新这款的 iPhone 程序与着色器库
en: Updating this game's iPhone program and shader library

source: 更新这款的 Mac 着色器库
en: Updating this game's Mac shader library

source: 让 Apple TV 开着、别让它休眠，和这台 Mac 连同一个网络，再点一次「装到 Apple TV」；已经传到电视上的部分不重传，电视上的 App 和存档都保留。
en: Keep the Apple TV on and awake, on the same network as this Mac, then click "Install on Apple TV" again; what already reached the TV is not sent again, and the app and saves on the TV are kept.

source: 查看本任务日志里签名那一步的报错；确认 Xcode「设置 → 账户」里登录了你的 Apple ID、能给这台 Apple TV 签名，再试一次。
en: Check the signing step's error in this task's log; make sure your Apple ID is signed in under Xcode Settings → Accounts and can sign for this Apple TV, then try again.

source: 让 Apple TV 开着、和这台 Mac 连同一个网络，再点一次「装到 Apple TV」；电视上原有的 App 和存档都保留。
en: Keep the Apple TV on and on the same network as this Mac, then click "Install on Apple TV" again; the app and saves already on the TV are kept.

source: 让 Apple TV 开着、和这台 Mac 连同一个网络，并在 Xcode「窗口 → 设备与模拟器」里和它配对过一次，再试一次。
en: Keep the Apple TV on and on the same network as this Mac, pair it once in Xcode's Window → Devices and Simulators, then try again.

source: 让 Apple TV 开着、别让它休眠，和这台 Mac 连同一个网络，再点一次「装到 Apple TV」。
en: Keep the Apple TV on and awake, on the same network as this Mac, then click "Install on Apple TV" again.

source: 这款的存档从手机上的另一个 S2Arm（{0}）复制进了新装的独立 App；那边的存档没动，在新 App 里确认进度没问题再删旧的。
en: This game's save was copied from another S2Arm on the phone ({0}) into the newly installed Standalone App. The save there was left untouched; check your progress in the new app before deleting the old one.

source: 手机上有几个 S2Arm 都存着这款的存档（{0}），没替你挑：在启动器的手机存档里选一份，还原到新装的独立 App。
en: Several S2Arm apps on the phone have a save for this game ({0}), so none was picked for you: in the launcher's phone saves, choose one and restore it to the newly installed Standalone App.

source: 新装的独立 App 用的是从旧 App 复制来的存档：进游戏确认进度没问题，再在 iPhone 上删掉旧 App。
en: The new Standalone App uses the save copied from the old app: open the game and check your progress, then delete the old app on the iPhone.

source: 在启动器的手机存档里选你要的那一份，还原到新装的独立 App；其余几个 App 里的存档都没动。
en: In the launcher's phone saves, pick the save you want and restore it to the newly installed Standalone App; the saves in the other apps were left untouched.

source: 手机上的另一个 S2Arm（{0}）里有这款的存档，但缺存档索引或用户档案，没有复制（拷过去游戏也认不出）：先别删那个 App。
en: Another S2Arm on the phone ({0}) has a save for this game, but its save index or user profile is missing, so it was not copied (the game wouldn't recognize it). Don't delete that app yet.

source: 那个 App 里这款的存档没动：先别删它。在它里面进一次这款游戏、回到主界面后，再从启动器导出到这台手机一次。
en: This game's save in that app is untouched, so don't delete it. Open this game in that app once and return to its main screen, then export to this phone from the launcher again.

source: 新装的独立 App 里这款已有存档，没有覆盖；旧进度还在手机上的另一个 S2Arm（{0}）里，先别删那个 App。
en: The newly installed Standalone App already has a save for this game, so nothing was overwritten. The old progress is still in another S2Arm on the phone ({0}); don't delete that app yet.

source: 旧进度还在原来那个 App 里，一个字节没动：先别删它。
en: The old progress is still in the original app, untouched; don't delete it yet.

source: 从手机上的另一个 S2Arm（{0}）复制这款的存档时中断，已撤回、新 App 里没留下半份；旧存档没动，先别删那个 App，连好手机后再导出一次。
en: Copying this game's save from another S2Arm on the phone ({0}) was interrupted and rolled back, leaving nothing half-copied in the new app. The old save is untouched; don't delete that app, and export again once the phone is connected.

source: 手机连稳（数据线插好、解锁）后，对这款再导出到这台手机一次，会重新复制。
en: With the phone firmly connected (cable in, unlocked), export this game to this phone again and the save will be copied again.

source: 这款游戏要的地址范围比 macOS 能给 App 的多（每台 Mac 都一样，和内存大小、存储空间都无关，换 Mac 没有用）：可能会卡或停在开头，我们在改进；游戏照常能启动。
en: This game needs more address range than macOS can give apps (it is the same on every Mac and has nothing to do with memory size or storage space, so another Mac won't help): it may be slow or stay at the beginning, and we're working on it; the game still starts.

source: S2Arm 自带的读取工具 nx_unpack.exe 不见了：是杀毒软件把它当成病毒隔离了。到「Windows 安全中心 → 保护历史记录」里把它还原并允许，把 S2Arm 安装文件夹加进信任后再点一次。
en: S2Arm's bundled reader nx_unpack.exe is gone: antivirus software quarantined it as a virus. Open Windows Security → Protection history, restore and allow it, add the S2Arm install folder to the trusted list, then try again.

source: 备份手机上各款的存档
en: Backing up saves for the games on the device

source: iPhone 已锁屏，宿主文件通道无法准备；请解锁手机后重试。
en: The iPhone is locked, so the host file channel can't be prepared. Unlock the phone and try again.

source: LiveContainer 文件访问失败：
en: LiveContainer file access failed:

source: 选的 LiveContainer 内部 S2Arm 已不在这台设备上，请重新选择。
en: The S2Arm you chose inside LiveContainer is no longer on this device. Choose again.

source: 请先选择这台手机内要使用的 S2Arm 容器。
en: First choose which S2Arm container on this phone to use.

source: LiveContainer 内部 S2Arm 容器已改变，请重新选择设备。
en: The S2Arm container inside LiveContainer has changed. Choose the device again.

source: S2Arm 还没建立导入目录，请在手机上打开它的游戏库后重试。
en: S2Arm hasn't created its import folder yet. Open its game library on the phone, then try again.

source: 上次推送的设备或容器已改变，请重新选择游戏后推送。
en: The device or container from the last push has changed. Choose the game again, then push.

source: 游戏号无效，无法定位要推送的游戏。
en: The game ID is invalid, so the game to push can't be found.

source: 准备推送到 LiveContainer 内部 S2Arm
en: Preparing to push to S2Arm inside LiveContainer

source: 正在推送到 LiveContainer：
en: Pushing to LiveContainer:

source: 正在同步 Mod：
en: Syncing mods:

source: 文件已发送到 LiveContainer 内部 S2Arm；回到游戏库完成导入，Mod 下次启动游戏时生效。
en: Files sent to S2Arm inside LiveContainer. Go back to its game library to finish importing; mods take effect the next time you start the game.

source: 手机上的游戏状态文件读不懂，请打开 S2Arm 游戏库后重试。
en: The game status file on the phone can't be read. Open the S2Arm game library, then try again.

source: 手机上的游戏状态格式暂不支持，请打开 S2Arm 游戏库后重试。
en: The game status format on the phone isn't supported yet. Open the S2Arm game library, then try again.

source: 手机上的游戏状态记录不完整，请打开 S2Arm 游戏库后重试。
en: The game status record on the phone is incomplete. Open the S2Arm game library, then try again.

source: 文件已发送，正在等待手机游戏库确认导入。
en: Files sent. Waiting for the phone's game library to confirm the import.

source: 这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 是 {1}，太旧了，读不了这个启动器（{2}）出的游戏程序，推进去也打不开：先在这台电脑的游戏库最前面「S2Arm」卡点「更新 S2Arm」装成 {3}，或回到当初装它的那台电脑更新，再推游戏。
en: S2Arm on this {0} is {1}, too old to read game programs prepared by this launcher ({2}); they would not open. First, in the S2Arm card at the front of the library on this computer, click Update S2Arm to install {3}, or update it on the computer that installed it, then push the game.

source: 这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 是 {1}，太旧了，读不了这个启动器（{2}）出的游戏程序，推进去也打不开：先在游戏库最前面「S2Arm」卡导出 {3} 的 S2Arm.ipa，用你当初装它的工具（LiveContainer / SideStore 等）重新装一次，再推游戏。
en: S2Arm on this {0} is {1}, too old to read game programs prepared by this launcher ({2}); they would not open. First export the {3} S2Arm.ipa from the S2Arm card at the front of the library and reinstall it with the tool you used before (LiveContainer, SideStore and so on), then push the game.

source: 这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 是 {1}，比电脑上的 {2} 旧，部分修复要更新 App 才生效：在这台电脑的游戏库最前面「S2Arm」卡点「更新 S2Arm」装成 {3}（之后这台电脑就认它），或回到当初装它的那台电脑更新。也可以先照旧推。
en: S2Arm on this {0} is {1}, older than {2} on this computer, and some fixes only take effect after updating the app: in the S2Arm card at the front of the library on this computer, click Update S2Arm to install {3} (this computer then recognizes it), or update it on the computer that installed it. You can also push anyway.

source: 这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 是 {1}，比电脑上的 {2} 旧，部分修复要更新 App 才生效：在游戏库最前面「S2Arm」卡导出 {3} 的 S2Arm.ipa，用你当初装它的工具（LiveContainer / SideStore 等）重新装一次。也可以先照旧推。
en: S2Arm on this {0} is {1}, older than {2} on this computer, and some fixes only take effect after updating the app: export the {3} S2Arm.ipa from the S2Arm card at the front of the library and reinstall it with the tool you used before (LiveContainer, SideStore and so on). You can also push anyway.

source: 想马上用上新版修复就照上面说的先更新这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm；不急的话点「仍然继续」照旧推。
en: To get the newer fixes now, update S2Arm on this {0} as described above; otherwise click Continue Anyway to push as before.

source: 照上面说的把这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 更新到这一版，再点这台的「重试」。
en: Update S2Arm on this {0} to this version as described above, then click Retry for this device.

source: 这款游戏在这台电脑上还没玩过：存档会在下次在这台电脑上启动这款时放进去；推到 iPhone / iPad 的这款不带这份存档。
en: You haven't played this game on this computer yet: the save goes in the next time you start this game on this computer; the copy pushed to iPhone / iPad doesn't get it.

source: 删掉待放入的存档
en: Discarding the waiting save

source: 你的 Apple ID 团队里还没登记任何 iPhone / iPad，电脑上签不了，这份游戏包未签名，导入后由手机上的 S2Arm 签名。
en: Your Apple ID team has no iPhone or iPad registered yet, so this computer can't sign: this game package is unsigned, and S2Arm on the phone signs it after import.

source: 你的 Apple ID 团队里还没登记任何 iPhone / iPad，电脑上签不了，这份游戏包未签名；手机上的 S2Arm 还没拿到签名身份，导入后签不了。用 AltStore 或 SideStore 装的 S2Arm：在它们的设置里导出签名证书，到手机上 S2Arm 齿轮 →「签名证书」→「导入 .p12…」导入。
en: Your Apple ID team has no iPhone or iPad registered yet, so this computer can't sign: this game package is unsigned, and S2Arm on the phone doesn't have a signing identity yet, so it can't sign it after import. If you installed S2Arm with AltStore or SideStore: export the signing certificate in their settings, then on the phone open S2Arm's gear → “Signing Certificate” → “Import .p12…”.

source: 想在电脑上签：用数据线把 iPhone 连上这台电脑、解锁并点「信任」，在启动器里推一次游戏（会把这台登记进你的团队），再导出。
en: To sign on this computer: connect the iPhone with a cable, unlock it and tap “Trust”, push a game once from the launcher (this registers the device to your team), then export again.

source: 这台 {0} 不认这次签名用的开发证书（手机说它已失效）。常见原因：在 AltStore、SideStore、iloader 等别的工具里新建或撤销过这个 Apple ID 的证书，把 S2Arm 在用的那张顶掉了；或者这台 {0} 的日期时间不对。办法：在 {0} 上打开「设置 → 通用 → 日期与时间」里的「自动设置」，再点一次重试：S2Arm 签名前会重新向 Apple 核这张证书，已被撤掉的会换一张新的（要撤别的工具的证书时会先问你）。手机上已装的 App 和存档都不受影响。
en: This {0} doesn't accept the development certificate used for this signature (it says the certificate is no longer valid). Common causes: another tool such as AltStore, SideStore or iloader created or revoked certificates for this Apple ID and pushed out the one S2Arm was using, or the date and time on this {0} are wrong. To fix it: on the {0}, turn on “Set Automatically” in Settings → General → Date & Time, then retry. Before signing, S2Arm checks the certificate with Apple again and replaces one that was revoked (it asks you first if another tool's certificate would be revoked). Apps and saves already on the phone are not affected.

source: 所有游戏的默认只有玩家 1 的一份。
en: The default for all games applies to player 1 only.

source: 诊断码不对：请从帖子里完整复制那一整串（以 S2A-DIAG1- 开头），再粘一次。
en: That diagnostic code isn't right: copy the whole string from the post (it starts with S2A-DIAG1-) and paste it again.

source: 已收下诊断码（游戏 {0}）：下次把这款推到 iPhone（或在这台 Mac 上开它）时生效一局，玩完自动失效。
en: Diagnostic code saved (game {0}): it takes effect for one session the next time you push this game to your iPhone (or open it on this Mac), then expires.

source: 已收下诊断码：下次推到 iPhone（或在这台 Mac 上开）的那一款生效一局，玩完自动失效。
en: Diagnostic code saved: it takes effect for one session in the next game you push to your iPhone (or open on this Mac), then expires.

source: 诊断码已清掉。
en: Diagnostic code cleared.

source: 诊断码已写进 iPhone：下一局生效一次，玩完请在 S2Arm 里导出诊断包。
en: Diagnostic code written to your iPhone: it takes effect once in the next session. Afterwards, export a diagnostic package in S2Arm.

source: 不支持的诊断码操作。
en: Unsupported diagnostic code action.

source: 这台 {0} 上要推进去的「{1}」看起来是一款游戏的独立 App：它只玩自己带的那一款，推别的游戏进去不会出现，这次就不推了。请装一个通用 S2Arm（游戏库最前面「S2Arm」卡）再推；如果它其实就是通用 S2Arm，用当初装它的工具装一次这一版的 S2Arm.ipa 再推。
en: The "{1}" you're pushing to on this {0} looks like a standalone App for one game: it only plays the game it came with, so other games pushed into it would not show up. Nothing was pushed. Install a general S2Arm (the "S2Arm" card at the front of the game library) and push again; if it really is a general S2Arm, reinstall this version's S2Arm.ipa with the tool you originally used, then push again.

source: 装一个通用 S2Arm（游戏库最前面「S2Arm」卡）后再推；如果它其实就是通用 S2Arm，用当初装它的工具装一次这一版的 S2Arm.ipa，再点这台的「重试」。
en: Install a general S2Arm (the "S2Arm" card at the front of the game library) and push again; if it really is a general S2Arm, reinstall this version's S2Arm.ipa with the tool you originally used, then click Retry for this device.
